recipes.title: BBQ Oven Baked Ribs
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 385 degrees.
Brush ribs with canola oil.
Prepare seasoning mixture by adding onion powder, garlic powder, black pepper, and salt to a small bowl. Season ribs generously with this seasoning mixture.
Wrap ribs with aluminum foil and place into the oven for 3.5 hours.
Remove ribs and brush with barbecue sauce.
Change the oven setting to broil and cook ribs for an additional 2 minutes.
Rebrush with more barbecue sauce per preference.
recipes.author: Soul Food Cooking

recipes.title: Beef Stew
recipes.instructions:
Heat pan on medium-high heat with oil.
Add beef. Season generously with salt. Cook for 7-10 minutes until well browned and seared.
Transfer beef to large stew pot.
Deglaze pan with ½ cup water and then add to stew pot.
Add more oil to pan. Add carrots, onions, and celery. Saute for 4-6 minutes until caramelized.
Add garlic and cook for about 1 minute.
Add everything to stew pot.
To pan add 2 tbsp butter until melted. Then add mushrooms. Brown mushrooms for 4-5 minutes. Then season with salt. Add flour and toss with mushrooms for about 1 minute. Add everything to pot.
To pot, add the red wine, tomato sauce, Worcerstershire sauce, paprika, suga, italian herbs, salt, black peper, and beef broth.
Cover pot and set to high heat until boiling. Lower heat and simmer for 1-1.5 hours.
Add potatoes and peas. Cook for 20 minutes until potatoes are fork tender.
Top with freshly chopped parsley.
recipes.author: Tatyana’s Everyday Food

ingredients.name_text: ½ Tsp of Italian herbs (Thyme, Oregano?)

recipes.title: Chili
recipes.instructions:
On high heat, add oil to the dutch oven. Add ground beef and let it brown on one side.
Mix and let brown more
Add onions and garlic. Mix and cook until onions are a little soft.
Season with salt and pepper.
Add tomato paste and spices (oregano, chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, cumin). Mix and cook to let spices bloom.
Add diced tomatoes. (Add peppers at this time if using in recipe).
Add chicken stock.
Add beans and mix.
Add bay leaves and let simmer for a bit.
Add fish sauce and sugar to taste.
recipes.author: Kenji Lopez
recipes.notes: - Can use **flour** to thicken chili. - Can top with **cheese**, **green onions**, **sour cream**, and **cilantro**.

ingredients.name_text: Optional: Jalapeno or habanero pepper, bell pepper

recipes.title: Cheeseburger and Fries
recipes.instructions:
Prepare Dill Pickles and Crispy Oven Baked French Fries.
Season ground beef with onion powder, garlic powder, and black pepper per preference. Mix in with beef. Roll beef into balls/patties..
Prepare sauce.
Cook onions to preference.
Salt tomatoes.
Toast hamburger buns in the toaster oven or on a pan with butter/oil.
Heat pan on high heat. Add a hamburger ball and smash to preferred size. Season top with salt and pepper. Cook until browned. Flip, season, and cook the other side. Add cheese to top of the patty.
Assemble burgers with bun, sauce, patty, tomatoes, dill pickles, onions, and lettuce.
Serve with fries on the side.
recipes.author: Junmac

recipes.title: Holy Basil Stir Fry (Pad Kra Pao)
recipes.instructions:
Heat pan on high. Add beef once hot and brown. Cook until some searing/browning, then lower heat.
Add oil and add garlic and chilis to side of beef.. Saute. Increase heat.
Add ½ cup of water or unsalted stock.
Add fish sauce and sugar.
Stir fry until sauce reduced.
Add julienned bell peppers for color and crunch.
Turn off heat and add basil leaves.
Top with fried egg and serve with rice.
Top egg with a little bit of Prik Nam Pla
recipes.author: Pailin’s Kitchen

ingredients.name_text: Fresno chilis, minced or mashed (mild red chilis)
Holy basil or Thai basil or Italian basil

recipes.title: Sinigang incomplete
recipes.instructions:
Cook pork with water until boiling, then toss water.
Rinse/wash meat.
In a pot, boil beef on high heat while covered with salt and pepper for 1-3 hours to tenderize. Once you can poke through with a fork, cook for another 30 minutes.
In a separate pot, heat oil on medium. Add garlic and onions. Add Achuete package when hot. Add some of the beef broth from the pot.
Once boiling, add eggplant and green beans. Cook for 5-10 minutes.
Add peanut butter and mix. Can add more per preference of thickness and taste.
Add meat to pot.
Add bok choy at the end. Can add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve with shrimp paste (Bagoong)
recipes.author: Otakoyakisoba
recipes.notes: Could

recipes.title: Kare Kare
recipes.instructions:
Cook beef with water until boiling, then toss water.
Rinse/wash meat.
In a pot, boil beef on low-medium heat while covered with salt and pepper for 1-3 hours to tenderize. Once you can poke through with a fork, cook for another 30 minutes.
In a separate pot, heat oil on medium. Add garlic and onions. Add Achuete package when hot. Add some of the beef broth from the pot.
Once boiling, add eggplant and green beans. Cook for 5-10 minutes.
Add peanut butter and mix. Can add more per preference of thickness and taste.
Add meat to pot.
Add bok choy at the end. Can add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve with shrimp paste (Bagoong)
recipes.author: Mama Tessie

ingredients.name_text: Green beans, Long beans, or String beans, sliced into 2-3 inch pieces
Bok choy, Napa cabbage, or Romaine lettuce

recipes.title: Beef Steak
recipes.instructions:
Marinate beef with Orchid’s Korean BBQ Sauce for 1-2 days
Heat pan on medium with olive oil.
Cook meat until brown.
Saute onions in a separate pan with olive oil.
Combine onions and meat.
Add green onions and cook for 2o seconds.
Serve with white rice.
recipes.author: Mama Tessie
recipes.notes: If not marinating, cook meat first, then add sauce and cook. Alternative to Orchid’s Korean BBQ Sauce: - 1 Part soy sauce - 1 Part vinegar - 1 Part fish sauce - 1 Part sugar

ingredients.name_text: Rib eye beef, sliced into bite sized pieces

recipes.title: Beef Tapa
recipes.instructions:
Make marinade by mixing all marinade ingredients.
Marinade beef in marinade for 1 day in the refrigerator or cook right away.
Cook pork on medium heat until fully cooked and slightly browned.
Serve with rice.
recipes.author: RV Manabat
recipes.notes: **For Tapsilog** (Tapa breakfast meal), serve with: - Garlic Fried Rice - Sukang Sawsawan (Spiced Vinegar) - Fried egg - Tomatoes (Roma preferred), chopped into small pieces

ingredients.name_text: cola, Apple juice, or Pineapple juice

recipes.title: Garlic Pepper Beef
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil on medium heat.
Add garlic until slightly browned, then add beef.
Add black pepper and soy sauce. Cook until beef is cooked, and then set aside.
Add butter to the pan.
Add flour until some browning.
Optional to add a beef cube or beef bouillon.
Add 3 Tbsp water.
Add garlic powder.
Top off with a few cracks of black pepper.
recipes.author: Ninong Ry

recipes.title: Gochujang Stew (Jjiggae)
recipes.instructions:
Cook the pan/wok on low heat with vegetable oil and sesame oil.
Add Gochujang .
Once bubbling, add Gochugaru and then 2.5 cups of water immediately.
Raise to medium-high heat and add potatoes and beef.
Add garlic, soy sauce, and fish sauce. Boil for 5 minutes until fish sauce is cooked away and potatoes are soft.
Add onions, mushrooms, and green chili peppers. Boil and stir for 5-10 minutes.
Add green onions.
Add 8 cracks of black pepper.
Can add water if too salty.
Serve with white rice.
recipes.author: Future Neighbor

ingredients.name_text: Green chili peppers or 1 jalapeno, thinly chopped

recipes.title: Gyudon (Beef Rice Bowl)
recipes.instructions:
To pan, add dashi stock, sake, soy sauce, sugar, and onions. Bring to a simmer and cook until onions are tender.
Add beef and cook until water is reduced to 1/3. About 5 minutes.
Add ginger to the pan and mix.
Adjust with sugar or soy sauce per preference.
Serve over rice with eggs and shichimi togarashi.
recipes.author: Kenji Lopez
recipes.notes: Could be served with beni-shoga (pickled ginger).

ingredients.name_text: Beef, thinly sliced (Beef chuck or rib eye)

recipes.title: Honey Beef
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil on medium heat.
Add beef and soy sauce. Cook until brown.
Add onions. Cook and then set aside.
Add butter to the pan.
Once butter is melted, add flour. Mix.
Add 3 Tbsp water.
Add oyster sauce or hoisin sauce.
Add honey.
Turn off heat and add 1 Tbsp butter.
Stir to melt butter. Emulsify butter.
Serve right away before the sauce becomes runny.
recipes.author: Ninong Ry

recipes.title: Mongolian Beef
recipes.instructions:
Wash beef in a bowl with water to rinse out myoglobin. Drain and set aside.
Prepare Marinade by mixing all ingredients in a mixing bowl.
Squeeze out extra water from beef, then mix beef into Marinade until dry.
Prepare vegetables at this time.
Prepare Sauce by mixing ingredients into a bowl.
Add 1-2 Tbsp of oil to beef once done marinating and mix to seal in marinade. Add 1.5 Tbsp cornstarch to beef and mix.
Heat pan on high until hot. Add oil and heat on high, enough oil to fry beef.
Add beef and cook for 1.5 minutes. Should be slightly crispy. Remove beef and let oil drain off. The oil can be saved and used to cook other meals.
Heat pan with some oil on medium.. Add garlic and chili peppers. Then add onions and white portion of green onions. Then add bell peppers. Stir fry until cooked, about 1-1.5 minutes.
Add beef. After 20 seconds, add the Sauce and green portion of green onions. Cook for about 30 seconds.
Add 1 Tbsp sesame oil and cook for 20 seconds.
Serve with rice.
recipes.author: Made With Lau
recipes.notes: Cut beef against the grain for tenderness.

ingredients.name_text: Beef (flank steak, new york), thinly sliced
Onion (red or white), sliced into ¼ inch strips
Green onions, sliced into 2 inch pieces
Optional: 1-2 Red/Green bell peppers for color, sliced

recipes.title: Spicy Beef Bulgogi
recipes.instructions:
Prepare Sauce by mixing ingredients into a bowl.
Add beef to marinade and mix. Can marinade or cook right away.
Heat pan on medium-high with oil until hot.
Cook green onions and mushrooms for 1 minute.
Add beef with marinade and cook on medium.
Once cooked, remove meat and vegetables. Add rice and sliced kimchi to prepare kimchi fried rice.
recipes.author: Maangchi

ingredients.name_text: Beef (flank steak, new york), thinly sliced
Green onion stalks, sliced into 2-3 inch pieces

recipes.title: Thai Mint Beef
recipes.instructions:
Prepare marinade by mixing ingredients into a bowl. Marinade beef in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.
Prepare dressing by mixing ingredients in a bowl.
Heat pan on medium with oil until hot.
Cook beef on the pan or grill until medium to medium-rare.
Once beef is cooked add shallots and green onion. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Turn off heat, add mint and cilantro and mix.
Add dressing ingredients and toss.
Before serving, add ground toasted rice.
Serve with rice.
recipes.notes: To make ground toasted rice, heat raw rice in a pan until golden brown. Can add a lime leaf when toasting. Then grind in a mortar and pestle.

ingredients.name_text: Beef (flank steak, new york), thinly sliced

recipes.title: Tomato Beef Stir Fry
recipes.instructions:
Dissolve baking soda in water and add to beef. Mix, then add the rest of the marinade ingredients.
Prepare sauce.
If serving with eggs, can cook eggs first in oil, then set aside.
On high heat with oil, add beef and cook until 90% done. Set side.
On medium-high heat, and more oil and add garlic, ginger, and shallots until garlic starts to turn golden.
Add tomatoes and toss just until the exterior starts to soften. ~30 seconds.
Turn heat to high and add beef and whites of green onions.
Add sauce and toss until the sauce is bubbling. ~30 seconds.
Turn off the heat and stir in green onions.
Serve with rice and eggs.
recipes.author: Pailin’s Kitchen
recipes.notes: Cut beef against the grain for tenderness.

ingredients.name_text: Beef (flank steak, new york), thinly sliced
Roma tomatoes, sliced into wedges (3-4 tomatoes)

recipes.title: Reverse Sear Steak
recipes.instructions:
Can salt steak the night before and place onto drying rack. Salt a lot. You want surface of steak to be as dry as possible before cooking. Can put in fridge for 1-7 days.
Season with pepper.
Cook in oven at 250 degrees F. May take 2+ hours.
Super hot pan. Add neutral high temp oil.
Add steak to pan. Sear each side for a couple of minutes. Until brown.
recipes.author: Kenji Lopez
recipes.notes: Good for 1.5+ inch steaks.Can serve with Chimichurri Sauce.

recipes.title: Steak
recipes.instructions:
Salt the steak generously and place onto a drying rack. Place in the refrigerator for 1-3 days. Surface of steak should be as dry as possible.
Take the steak out of the refrigerator for 20 minutes.
Heat pan on high then add olive oil. Thicker steaks do not require as high heat to avoid burning. Get a nice sizzle.
Add steaks to pan to sear each side and flipping every minute or so.
Lower to medium heat and add 2 nobs of butter and 4 garlic cloves. Could add thyme.
Use a spoon to baste steak with butte and oil.
Cook until desired internal temperature is reached. Take steak off of pan 5-10 degrees early.

recipes.title: Pan-Fried Chicken Breast
recipes.instructions:
In a bowl, add 2 cups of water and 1 tsp salt.
Add chicken to fully submerge. Brine. For 30-60 minutes.
Cut chicken into 3 equal pieces against the grain. Then cut 1 inch thick chicken cutlets. Then pound chicken.
Make marinade: 2 Tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tsp light soy sauce, 1 Tbsp cooking wine, 1 Tsp sugar, ½ Tsp salt, ¼ Tsp white pepper, 2 Tbsp cornstarch, 1 Tbsp water, ½ oz grated ginger. Add meat and mix well.
½ onion sliced into thin strips (top to root), ½ red onon. 1 Tbsp oyster sauce, 2 Tsp Light soy sauce, 2 Tsp sugar, 1 Tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 Tsp cornstarch, 3 tbsp water,1 Tbsp cooking wine.
On plate place 2-3 tbsp cornstarch, dredge chicken in it.
Heat oil on high. Lay cutlets one at a time. Wait until golden brown before flipping. Fry for another minute.
Add onions and spread them out. Add 1 tsp cooking wine and cover for 30 seconds. Add sauce over chicken. Agitate and move chicken around. Cook each side low to medium heat for 3 minutes each. 165 degrees in center, can stop around 160.
Add 1 tsp sesame oil.
recipes.author: Made With Lau

ingredients.name_text: Chicken thighs or breasts, cut into 1 inch pieces

recipes.title: Arroz Caldo
recipes.instructions:
Heat the pot on medium heat and add olive oil to coat the bottom of the pot.
Add garlic and ginger until brown.
Add onions and saute.
Add chicken and saute to brown.
Add fish sauce and saute.
Cover pot to cook for a few minutes.
Add 6 cups of water.
Add rice and continue to cook on medium heat until rice is fully cooked, at least 10 minutes. Can cover the pot and monitor to ensure it does not overflow. Rice should be soft.
Add pepper and fish sauce to taste.
Can add green onions or serve on the side. Serve with lemon or lemon juice on the side.
recipes.author: Mama Tessie

ingredients.name_text: Chicken thighs or breasts, cut into 1 inch pieces

recipes.title: Black Pepper Chicken
recipes.instructions:
Add chili peppers and vinegar to the pot. Heat to boil and simmer for 15 seconds.
To chicken, add chili vinegar, soy sauce, ground ginger, and cornstarch. Mix and marinate for 30 minutes.
Pan on high heat with oil. Add chicken and stir fry for 5-7 minutes or until cooked. Remove chicken from the pan.
Then cook onion and celery. Stir fry then readd chicken and stir to combine.
Add 1 Tbsp Chili vinegar and 4 Tbsp soy sauce. Stir fry.
Add black pepper and stir fry for 30 seconds.
recipes.author: Tess Cooks 4u

ingredients.name_text: Chicken Thighs or Breast, sliced into small pieces (1 Costco pack)

recipes.title: Bourbon Chicken
recipes.instructions:
Coat chicken pieces in cornstarch.
Mix other ingredients to make sauce.
Heat pan on high olive oil in pan (~2 Tbsp)
Add chicken and cook a couple minutes on each side until cooked through. Nice browning. Once the edges are nice and golden, flip over. Then transfer to a bowl.
Add garlic and cook for 30-60 seconds until fragrant.
Add sauce ingredients and stir onto pan. Reduce to low and once it stops bubbling. Add chicken and cook until sauce reduces and thickens up. Chicken should be coated glossy.
Add green onions at the end.
recipes.author: Preppy Kitchen

ingredients.name_text: Chicken Thighs or Breast, sliced into small pieces (1 Costco pack)

recipes.title: Chicken Adobo
recipes.instructions:
Season chicken lightly with salt.
Heat oil in a wok or pot over medium-high heat until it shimmers. Add chicken and cook, turning occasionally until lightly brown.
Add ground pepper, peppercorns, and garlic. Stir to combine.
Add vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, and bay leaves. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, and then reduce to a bare simmer. Cover and cook for 3 minutes.
Stir and cook for another 1-2 minutes.
Check to ensure the temperature inside chicken is at least 155 degrees F. Cook until the chicken is fully tender.
Serve with white rice.
recipes.notes: Can use full skin-on chicken thighs or drumsticks that are not sliced, but when boiling with cover, will need to cook for 20-30 minutes.

ingredients.name_text: Chicken thighs or breasts, sliced into cubes
Alternatives: Japanese shoyu or mix of Chinese dark and light soy sauce

recipes.title: Chicken Cutlet
recipes.instructions:
Slice breast in half horizontally. Mash flat with mallet into ¼ inch thickness.
Season both sides with salt and pepper.
Take 3 dredging trays and fill each with flour, eggs, and bread crumbs.
Dip chicken into flour and shake off excess. Dip into egg then into bread crumbs. Cover with a good amount of crumbs and gently press down on chicken to ensure bread crumbs stick.
Fill the pan with enough oil to cover chicken. Heat oil to 320-340 °F. Fry for about 6-8 minutes.
Let rest on a cooling rack.
recipes.author: Aaron and Claire
recipes.notes: For chicken katsu, can serve with Katsu Sauce and lemon.Can serve with onions, green onions, eggs, dashi. Katsu don?

recipes.title: Green Curry
recipes.instructions:
In a pot, boil ½ cup coconut milk. Add Thai green curry paste. Could add less paste if too spicy.
Cook until reduced until you see coconut oil separated from the paste. Should be thick in consistency.
Add chicken thigh and mix. If using breasts, cook for less time.
Add 1 cup coconut milk, and 1 cup of chicken stock. Ratio of chicken stock is up to you, if you want lighter, more chicken stock. If more rich, more coconut milk.
Season with 1 Tbsp fish sauce and sugar. Add lime leaves. Simmer gently for about 15 minutes until the chicken is fork tender.
Add vegetables and red bell pepper, chilis before the chicken is done. Timing may vary depending on the vegetable.
Cook and gently simmer, not boiling.
Taste and adjust seasoning with fish sauce. Taste should be strong because it will be diluted with rice.
Finish with thai basil.
recipes.author: Pailin’s Kitchen
recipes.notes: Could add ~10 mashed basil leaves to increase green color.

ingredients.name_text: Chicken thighs or breast, sliced into cubes

recipes.title: Japanese Curry
recipes.instructions:
Heat the pan on medium-high with 4 Tbsp of oil or butter.
Add chicken and fry. Add salt and pepper. Cook for a few minutes.
Add onions and fry for a few minutes.
Add garlic and ginger. Fry for a minute until aromatic.
Add curry powder and flour. Toast for a minute.
Add chicken broth.
Add potatoes and carrots. Cook until simmer.
Add honey.
Can add water or more chicken broth if too thick.
Raise to high heat and simmer, then lower and cook for about 10 minutes. Cook until potatoes are ready.
Season with salt and pepper, and MSG.
Serve with rice.
Can add Fish sauce for seasoning.
recipes.author: Kenji Lopez

ingredients.name_text: Chicken thighs or breast, sliced into cubes
Carrot, peeled and sliced into chunks
Potato, peeled and sliced into chunks

recipes.title: Japanese Curry
recipes.instructions:
On a medium heat pot with oil, add onions. Cook for 5 minutes. Can cook for another 5 minutes if time permits so onions are caramelized.
Add garlic and ginger. Mix.
Add chicken and stir fry until no longer pink on the outside. Can lower heat if onions are getting too brown..
Add chicken broth, apple, honey, soy sauce, and ketchup.
Add carrots and potatoes (If russet potatoes, add in the last 15-20 minutes of cooking). Broth should barely cover the ingredients.
Simmer covered on medium-low heat for 15 minutes. Can simmer uncovered if ingredients are completely submerged in broth.
Skim scum and foam from the surface of broth.
Continue to cook until carrots and potatoes can be pierced with a fork easily.
Turn off the heat and add curry roux. Slowly let it dissolve in a spoon.
Simmer uncovered on medium low while stirring frequently until thick, typically about 5-10 minutes. If too thick, add water.
Season with salt and pepper, and MSG. Can add curry spice if needed.
recipes.author: Just One Cookbook
recipes.notes: Could be served with beni-shoga (pickled ginger). To reheat, add water.Can substitute meat with beef, pork, shrimp tofu, mushrooms. Can substitute apple with banana, orange/apricot jam, mirin, or apple sauce.For refreshing/sour taste, can add lemon, tomato, or yogurt.For spicy, can add red chili pepper, black pepper, cayenne pepper.For fragrance, can add cumin, cinnamon, bay leaf, curr leaves.For umami and depth, can add butter, chocolate, garlic cloves, instant coffee, milk, oyster sauce, red wine, sake, tonkatsu sauce, worcestershire sauce.

ingredients.name_text: Chicken thighs or breast, sliced into cubes
Carrots, peeled and sliced into chunks
Potato, peeled and sliced into chunks

recipes.title: Mushroom Chicken
recipes.instructions:
To chicken, add marinade ingredients. Mix and marinate for 30 minutes.
Boil mushrooms and zucchini, blanch for 30 seconds.
Pan on high heat with oil. Add chicken and stir fry for 5-7 minutes or until cooked. Remove chicken from pan.
Then cook garlic and ginger. Cook and stir for 20-30 seconds, then add sauce ingredients. Simmer for 1-2 minutes.
Then add blanched vegetables and chicken. Add some cornstarch slurry to thicken sauce, a little at a time.
recipes.author: Tess Cooks 4u

ingredients.name_text: Chicken Thighs or Breast, sliced into small pieces (1 Costco pack)
Chicken broth or water with ¼ Tsp Bouillon
Chinese cooking wine or Rice wine vinegar

recipes.title: Oyakodon
recipes.instructions:
To pan, add dashi stock, sake, soy sauce, sugar, chicken, and onions. Bring to a simmer on medium heat and cover.
To bowl, add egg. Could add salt, or soy sauce + dashi powder + green onions. Beat it.
Flip chicken. Cover again. Total cooking of chicken about 7 minutes.
Once chicken is cooked. Pour egg over the top. Cover and cook for 15-30 seconds.
Adjust with sugar or soy sauce per preference.
Serve over rice with eggs and shichimi togarashi.
recipes.author: Kenji Lopez Alt
recipes.notes: Could be served with beni-shoga (pickled ginger).

ingredients.name_text: Chicken Breasts or thighs, sliced into bite sized pieces

recipes.title: Poached Chicken with Ginger Scallion Sauce
recipes.instructions:
Start with cold water in a pot to cover ingredients.
Add chicken and salt/pepper to the pot. (Optional: Add garlic, ginger, onions).
Cook on high heat until the pot starts to simmer, then low to medium heat immediately.
For a gentle poach, avoid boiling or simmering.
Cook for 10 minutes on medium heat. Check with a thermometer that chicken is cooked to 160 degrees F.
Serve with white rice and Ginger Scallion Sauce.
recipes.author: Junmac
recipes.notes: Can prepare Ginger Scallion Sauce while poaching chicken.

recipes.title: Chicken Tacos with Avocado Crema
recipes.instructions:
Coat chicken with paprika, cumin, dehydrated onion, dehydrated garlic, salt, and pepper. Cook. Shred.
Prepare avocado cilantro dressing with boiled or roasted onion and jalapeno blended in.
Prepare spanish rice and refried beans.
Toast with tortillas lightly fried with oil per preference.
Serve with lime and cilantro.
Can serve with tortilla chips (deep fried corn tortillas at 375 degrees until no longer bubbling, salted) and pico de gallo.

ingredients.name_text: Chicken thighs or breast, sliced into cubes

recipes.title: Red Curry
recipes.instructions:
In pot, boil ½ cup coconut milk. Add thai red curry paste. Could add less paste if too spicy.
Cook until reduced until you see coconut oil separated from the paste. Should be thick in consistency.
Add chicken thigh. If using breasts, cook for less time.
Add 1 cup coconut milk, and 1 cup of chicken stock. Ratio of chicken stock is up to you, if want lighter, more chicken stock. If more rich, more coconut milk.
Season with 1 Tbsp fish sauce and sugar. Simmer gently for about 15 minutes until chicken is fork tender.
About 8 minutes before chicken is done, add squash. May vary depending on vegetable. Can overcook quickly.
Cook and gently simmer, not boiling.
Taste and adjust seasoning. Taste should be strong because will be diluted with rice.
Finish with thai basil.
Could also add bell peppers or something red.
recipes.author: Pailin’s Kitchen

ingredients.name_text: Chicken thighs or breast, sliced into cubes

recipes.title: Red Curry Stir Fry
recipes.instructions:
Add fish sauce to chicken.
Heat oil on medium heat. Add curry paste and mix with oil.
Add some coconut milk and sugar. Reduce coconut milk down until thick. Will see oil seep out of edges.
Add chicken and mix. Add rest of coconut milk.
Add vegetables and stir fry.
Add tomatoes or red bell pepper at the end.
Taste and adjust with fish sauce.
Finish with thai basil.
recipes.author: Pailin’s Kitchen
recipes.notes: Could

ingredients.name_text: Chicken thighs or breast, sliced into cubes
Pop of red, cherry tomatoes or red bell pepper

recipes.title: Air Fried Chicken Wings
recipes.instructions:
Pat dry chicken wings with clean paper towels.
Once the wings are dry, add to the mixing bowl. Add all ingredients to the bowl.
Toss chicken until coated.
Preheat the air fryer to 400 G for 2 minutes.
If using buffalo sauce, place wings in a mixing bowl, cover with Buffalo Sauce, and toss together to coat.
Can serve with Buttermilk Ranch and/or celery.
recipes.author: Domestic Superhero
recipes.notes: Can coat with Honey BBQ Buffalo Sauce instead of Buffalo sauce.

recipes.title: Baked Buffalo Chicken Wings
recipes.instructions:
If using water chilled chicken wings, will want to let it rest 8-24 hours.
If air chilled, can pat dry chicken wings with clean paper towels.
Once the wings are dry, add to the mixing bowl. Add salt, baking powder, and cornstarch to the bowl.
Toss chicken until coated. Coat should be dry and not pasty.
Put wings onto a cooking rack skin side up.
Place in the refrigerator for at least 8 hours.
Cook chicken in the oven at 450 degrees F for 15-30 minutes.
Prepare buffalo sauce.
Wings should be starting to get crispy and brown.
Flip wings and put back into the oven for another 15-30 minutes. Wings should be crispy.
Place wings in a mixing bowl, cover with Buffalo Sauce, and toss together to coat.
Serve with Buttermilk Ranch and/or celery.
recipes.author: Kenji Lopez
recipes.notes: Can coat with Honey BBQ Buffalo Sauce instead of Buffalo sauce..

ingredients.name_text: Kosher salt or 1.25 Tsp if using table salt

recipes.title: Baked Honey Sriracha Chicken Wings
recipes.instructions:
If using water chilled chicken wings, will want to let it rest 8-24 hours.
If air chilled, can pat dry chicken wings with clean paper towels.
Once the wings are dry, add to the mixing bowl. Add salt, black pepper, paprika, and baking powder.
Put wings onto a cooking rack skin side up.
Cook chicken in the oven at 425 degrees F, turning every 15-20 minutes, until they are browned and crispy. Total cooking time will be about 1 hour, but it depends on the size and temperature of the wings..
Prepare Honey Sriracha sauce.
Place wings in a mixing bowl, cover with Honey Sriracha Sauce, and toss together to coat.
recipes.author: Food Wishes

recipes.title: Chicken Wing Tom Yum Soup
recipes.instructions:
Boil 5 cups of water in a pot, then add chicken.
Add fish sauce, sugar, and shallots. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Add lemon grass and galangal. Crush Makrut lime leaves prior to putting in to soup.
Break open chili
Add mushrooms and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes and simmer for 2 minutes.
Turn off, add lime juice and cilantro.
recipes.author: Pailin’s Kitchen
recipes.notes: Galangal, lemon grass, and lime leaves are not edible.

ingredients.name_text: Lemon grass, smashed then cut into 2 inch piece, use base

recipes.title: Gaeng Jued (Bland soup)
recipes.instructions:
Boil 5 cups of water in a pot, then add chicken.
Add soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar, and white pepper.
Simmer for 5-10 minutes and remove scum.
Add cilantro stems and daikon.
Loosely cover the pot and let simmer until the meat is fork tender for a total of 20 minutes. Pork spare ribs should simmer for 30-40 minutes.
Add mushrooms and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes and simmer for 2 minutes.
Turn off, add lime juice and cilantro.
Soak glass noodles in water for 7-10 minutes until soft and pliable. Cut in half.
To make ½ lb meat balls, ground pork and ground chicken, 2 Tsp Soy sauce, 1 Tsp fish sauce, ¾ Tsp sugar, few cracks white pepper. Could add garlic. Mix. Optional.
Remove cilantro stems.
Bring up to boil, add meatballs in.
Add napa cabbage.
Add glass noodles, only takes 3 minutes to cook.
Top with fried garlic, garlic oil, and cilantro.
recipes.author: Pailin’s Kitchen
recipes.notes: Very flexible with vegetables and protein: napa cabbage, carrots, cucumber, mushrooms, baby corn.Protein is flexible with: pork meatballs, asian meatballs, tofu, thai omelet.Glass noodles can last longer in refrigerator than other noodles.

ingredients.name_text: Alternative: Pork spare ribs, cut into chunks
2-inch section Daikon or ¼ Onion, diced

recipes.title: Soy Sauce Chicken Wings
recipes.instructions:
Prepare sauce by mixing all ingredients listed.
Cut into thickest parts of chicken to help cook faster.
Next, blanch the wings, first boil 6 cups of hot water in a pot. Add wings to the pot and cook for 1.5 minutes.
Remove wings and set aside.
Remove water from the pot and dry.
Add 1 Tbsp oil and add ginger and garlic. Stir fry for 1 minute.
Add ½ Cup water and cover to simmer on low for 2 minutes.
Add half of the sauce mixture, and add in wings. Then add sauce over the wings.
Lower heat so that it is not boiling too quickly. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Uncover, flip wings. Cover and simmer again for 2 minutes. Uncover, and baste wings with sauce on high heat for 6 minutes.
Plate drum sticks and serve with sauce in a small bowl.
recipes.author: Made With Lau

recipes.title: Tomato Chicken (Indian)
recipes.instructions:
Marinate chicken for 20 minutes.**For Marinade:**1. ½ Tsp Turmeric powder
½ Tsp Black pepper
Salt to taste
Fry chicken in a pot with oil on medium high heat until golden brown. Set aside chicken.
To pot, add 2 Tbsp oil, bay leaf, cinnamon stick, cardamom pods, clove pods, and sugar. Cook until sugar is caramelized.
Add onion and cook until golden.
Add ginger and garlic. Cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato paste. Cook for 1 minute.
Add turmeric powder, coriander powder, and cumin powder. Cook for 1 minute.
Add black pepper, salt, red chili powder, and garam masala. Cook until oil separates.
Add in fried chicken and stir.
Add 1 cup of water or chicken stock, and stir. Cover and cook on medium to low heat for 15 minutes.
Add in tomato and stir.
Add in cilantro and stir.
recipes.author: TasteRecipeHut
recipes.notes: Can finish with lemon juice and/or MSG to taste.Can substitute with rotisserie chicken, but cook chicken for a shorter period. Use chicken stock instead of water.

recipes.title: Tinola
recipes.instructions:
On medium heat, add oil to the pot and sear chicken. Season chicken with salt and pepper. Cook until seared on both sides. Set chicken aside.
Add garlic and ginger to the pot, saute for 2 minutes.
Add onions to the pot and saute for 3 minutes.
Add chicken to the pot and add 5 Cups water. Add Chicken bouillon.
Turn on high heat until boiling. Then lower to a simmer and cook for 20 minutes.
Add sayote and cook for 10 minutes.
Add spinach and cook for 2 minutes.
Add fish sauce.
recipes.author: Buzzfeed
recipes.notes: Can season with fish oil, soy sauce, sriracha, and sesame oil per preference.

ingredients.name_text: Cube of Knorr Chicken powder or ½ Tsp Chicken bouillon

recipes.title: Egg Salad
recipes.instructions:
Use 9-minute hard boiled eggs.
Add all ingredients to the mixing bowl. Add salt and pepper to flavor.
Mix and break up eggs.
Can be served with bread, lettuce and tomato.
recipes.author: Kenji Lopez
recipes.notes: Can add in cooked minced chicken, lemon, or sugar. Can serve with sriracha.

recipes.title: Korean Scrambled Eggs
recipes.instructions:
On medium heat, add sesame oil to the pan.
Add in eggs, and scramble the white parts only while keeping the yolks intact.
When the egg whites are almost cooked through, turn off the heat and add soy sauce.
Break the egg yolks and mix.
Serve over rice with green onions.
recipes.author: Future Neighbor

recipes.title: Mayak Eggs
recipes.instructions:
On the bottom base of the egg, give a light tap to get a small crack without breaking the inner membrane.
Add water to a pot. Enough to cover eggs by 1 inch.
Add a pinch of salt and some vinegar.
Heat to boil, and then cook eggs for 6 minutes.
Cool eggs in an ice bath, and then peel.
Add all ingredients to a container and refrigerate for at least 5 hours.
recipes.author: Future Neighbor
recipes.notes: Could serve with rice and top with sesame oil.

recipes.title: Poached Egg
recipes.instructions:
Crack open the egg and transfer over a fine mesh strainer until excess egg whites are filtered.
Boil water to 180 °F water. The water should be quivering but not simmering.
Lower egg into water and carefully roll egg out from the strainer.
Once in water, keep moving the egg around with a spoon for about 3-4 minutes.
recipes.author: Kenji Lopez
recipes.notes: To test eggs for freshness, place the egg in a cup of water. A fresh egg will sink and lie flat.Can store poached egg in cold water in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Reheat in hot water for a few minutes.

recipes.title: Seasoned Eggs (For ramen)
recipes.instructions:
Add sugar, soy sauce, garlic, leek, and water to a pan. Boil until leek is sauce. Set aside.
Hard boil eggs for 6.5 minutes in boiling water.
Place eggs in ice water and peel.
Wrap eggs in kitchen paper and dip in sauce. Place in the refrigerator for at least 12 hours.
recipes.author: Kimono Mom
recipes.notes: Can be served with ramen.

recipes.title: Stir Fried Tomatoes and Eggs
recipes.instructions:
Crack eggs into a mixing bowl. Add a pinch of salt, sugar, and MSG. Beat the eggs.
In a separate bowl, mix oyster sauce and soy sauce.
Add oil to a pan/wok on high heat.
Once hot, add eggs to the pan and gently fold the eggs. When soft and a little runny, remove eggs and set aside.
Add oil and green onions into the pan. Add tomatoes and a pinch of salt. Pour the oyster sauce and soy sauce around the pan and stir-fry tomatoes gently.
Once it starts to bubble, add in the eggs and gently break it apart. Stir-fry for two minutes.
Serve over rice and add green onions on top.
recipes.author: Aaron and Claire
recipes.notes: Can cook with additional ingredients, including mushrooms, onions, garlic, and cilantro.

ingredients.name_text: Tomatoes, sliced into wedges or small pieces

recipes.title: Spanish Garlic Eggs
recipes.instructions:
To make the garlic parsley oil, to a mortar add garlic, salt, and parsley. Mash until it has a paste-like texture. Add extra virgin olive oil and mix. Set aside for now..
Heat the pan on medium heat with extra virgin olive oil.
Add garlic to the pan and saute for 30 seconds. Garlic should be lightly brown.
Crack eggs into a pan. Incorporate the slices of garlic into eggs and fry for 1-2 minutes until a golden crust forms on the bottom of the eggs. While cooking, splash oil on top of eggs to cook.
Remove eggs from the frying pan and remove excess oil. Plate.
Season eggs with salt and pepper. Top with garlic parsley oil.
recipes.author: Spain on a Fork
recipes.notes: As an alternative to the mortar, could use a handheld blender or food processor to prepare the olive oil topping.

recipes.title: Steamed Eggs in Microwave
recipes.instructions:
Seasoned soy sauce
- Heat pan with neutral oil
- Add shallots until wilted
- Add scallions and cilantro
- Light soy sauce
- Add water to help dilute
- Add dark soil sauce for color
- Maggi seasoning (MSG?), chicken bouillon
- White sugar
- Pinch of white pepper
- Simmer for 5 minutes and strain.
1/2 Cup cooked water, 2 eggs, pinch of salt
Add ½ Cup dashi or chicken stock
Mix and add pinch of salt.
Add over sieve to microwavable bowl.
Stir. Use spoon to remove bubbles.
Cover with plastic wrap. Poke a few holes.
Cook for 2 minutes and add 30 second increments until cooked to preference.
Top with soy sauce and green onions
recipes.author: Lucas from Food52

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Braised Fried Eggs
recipes.instructions:
Add generous amount of oil to pan and heat on high. Enough oil for a shallow fry.
Crack egg onto pan until brown edges. Then flip the egg until crispy. Remove and set aside.
Prepare sauce by mixing light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, chinese black vinegar, ketchup, sugar, water, and cornstarch. Can add some water to cornstarch first before adding.
With some oil in pan, add ginger and cook for 10 seconds. Add green onions, garlic, and chilis. Stir fry until aromatic.
Add sauce. Once boiling, add eggs to pan at a low simmer.
Toss in sauce at a low simmer for a 2 minutes.
Serve with rice.
recipes.author: Lucas Sin

ingredients.name_text: Green onions, sliced into ½ inch pieces
Red Chili, sliced into ½ inch pieces

recipes.title: Springrolls
recipes.notes: Can substitute protein for shrimp, Nem nuong que huong (pork) or any.

ingredients.name_text: Vermicelli rice noodle sheets (Banh hoi ba cay tre)

recipes.title: Braised Pork (Luo Fan)
recipes.instructions:
Prepare hard boiled eggs.
Add a small amount of oil to the pan and heat on high.
Add pork and stir fry until lightly brown. Water will seep out of the pork, keep cooking until dry. Then cook until some oil comes out.
Add shallots and stir fry.
Add garlic and stir fry for about 30 seconds.
Add mushrooms, five spice, white pepper, and chinese white rice wine. Stir fry.
Add soy sauces. Add white sugar. Stir fry.
Add chicken stock. And cover until boiling.
Add hard boiled eggs.
Cover and lower to low heat. Cook for 45-60 min.
Could cook longer for more meat.
Serve with rice and vegetables.
recipes.author: Spice N’ Pans

recipes.title: Chashu (For Ramen)
recipes.instructions:
Cook pork belly in a pan with oil to sear all sides.
Remove pork, then pour boiling water over pork to remove excess fat.
Wipe the oil from the pan and add sugar, soy sauce, sake, worcestershire sauce, and water.
Add pork and cook for 5 minutes with cover on. Flip and cook for another 5 minutes.
Slice
recipes.author: Kimono Mom
recipes.notes: Can be served with ramen.

recipes.title: Crispy Pork Belly
recipes.instructions:
To pot, boil 2 cups of water on high heat. Add pork belly skin down. After 1 minute flip and cook for 30 seconds. Remove and place in cool water.
Use a knife to scrape off skin to clean it. Dry with a paper towel.
Poke skin all over with a fork or tooth pick. This step is necessary for bubbling of skin. Just poke through the skin, not too deep.
Flip to meat side and score meat with a knife into 2 inch rectanlges.
Add five spice, black pepper, white pepper, and garlic salt to a bowl and mix. Rub seasoning mix onto meat side of pork belly, getting into gaps as well.
Optional: Add ground bean sauce and sugar to a bowl, mix, then paint onto meat side of pork belly.
Place meat onto foil, skin side up.
Sprinkle 1 Tbsp salt onto skin and rub it in. After 5 minutes, wipe off salt with a paper towel. Use a knife to scrape off all of salt.
Add vinegar to skin and spread onto it.
Refrigerate for at least 10-12 hours.
Heat oven to 375 degrees F. Place pork and foil on top of a cooling rack in a baking sheet. Add some water to the baking sheet. Place into oven and cook for 20-25 minutes.
Turn up heat to 425 degrees F and cook for 30-35 minutes.
Check on pork to make sure it is crispy and not burnt.
Can check temp of pork to be a minimum of 145 degrees F.
Remove pork and let rest for an hour before cutting along scores.
recipes.author: Made With Lau
recipes.notes: Can refrigerate for 2-3 days. Can freeze. To make crunchy, cook in oven or toaster again.Sauce: 1 Tbsp fish sauce, 1 Tbsp lime, Chili flakes, ¾ tsp Sugar, toasted rice powder, green onions or cilantroSauce: Toyomansi: 1-3 cloves garlic, 1-2 red chili, ¼ Cup calamansi juice, ¼ Cup soy sauce

ingredients.name_text: White vinegar or sweet rice vinegar

recipes.title: Al Pastor Tacos
recipes.instructions:
Cut stems of chiles and boil in hot water. Can remove seeds if preferred.
Place all ingredients, except the pork, into a blender to blend.
Marinate pork in marinade for up to 1-2 days.
Cook on a pan on high heat for 5 minutes, then flip and cook for another 5 minutes.
Serve as tacos with tortillas, salsa, chopped onions, limes, and cilantro.
recipes.author: Views on the Road
recipes.notes: Can serve with Spanish Rice and Refried Beans.

ingredients.name_text: Chiles Guajillo, California or New Mexico Chile
Peppercorns or ½ Tsp black pepper, ground
Apple cider vinegar or White vinegar
Optional: Juice of chipotle or chipotle pot

recipes.title: Carnitas and Salsa
recipes.instructions:
Season pork with salt and place into a dutch oven pot so it fits in a single layer.
Add bay leaves and onion to the pot.
Squeeze orange juice over pork and then add the orange to the pot.
Add cinnamon and garlic.
Add enough oil so it is covering the top of the layer and covering all the cracks.
Cover pot and place into oven at 275 degrees F for 3 hours.
Once pork is tender enough, it should shred when pushed with a fork. At this point, can drain and eat or crisp pork up as follows.
Take pork pieces and place onto a metal sheet, then set aside for now.
Peel tomatillos (Do not peel if using roma tomatoes) and slice in half. Place them face down onto another metal sheet.
Cut jalapeno in half and place face down onto the metal sheet. May remove seeds and stem for less spicy. Can add more peppers for more spice.
Smash 3-5 garlic cloves and add to the sheet.
Set the oven to broil and place the metal sheet with the tomatillos, jalapeno, and garlic into the oven until charred. Then transfer to a blender.
In the blender, also add onions from the dutch oven, a handful of cilantro (8-10 stems), a big pinch of salt, and juice from 1 lime. Blend roughly and ready serve. May adjust salt and lime as needed.
Shred pork with a couple of forks and spread evenly onto metal sheet. Broil until crispy and brown on top.
Can dip tortillas in carnitas braising liquid and heat on a skillet until pliable.
Serve as tacos with tortillas, chopped onions, limes, and cilantro.
recipes.author: Kenji Lopez-Alt
recipes.notes: Can serve with Spanish Rice and Refried Beans.

ingredients.name_text: Pork shoulder, sliced into 2 inch cubes

recipes.title: Char Siu
recipes.instructions:
Make marinade by mixing all marinade ingredients.
Marinade pork in marinade for 8-24 hours, not longer than 24 hours or the meat will get hard. Before cooking, let meat warm to room temp for at least 1 hour.
Place pork onto a baking rack on top over a baking tray lined with foil. Add 1-2 Tbsp of water to the tray.
Preheat oven to 425 degrees F
Cook pork for 15 minutes and lather both sides with pork marinade.
Cook pork for 15 minutes and lather both sides with pork marinade.
Dilute honey with 2 Tsp water.
Cook pork for 10 minutes and lather both sides with diluted honey
Cook for 5 minutes at 450 degrees F.
Lather both sides with diluted honey and let it cool for a few minutes before cutting into it.
recipes.author: Made With Lau

ingredients.name_text: Shaoxing wine (or Dry sherry, Mirin, sake)
Pork belly or shoulder, long 1 inch slices, poked with a fork

recipes.title: Jeyuk Bokkeum (Spicy Pork Bulgogi)
recipes.instructions:
Make marinade and add meat.
Heat pan on high heat with oil. Add garlic and green onions.
Add marinated meat.
Stir fry.
recipes.author: Josh from Seventeen

ingredients.name_text: Pork belly or shoulder, thinly sliced to bite size pieces

recipes.title: Pork Tocino
recipes.instructions:
Make marinade by mixing all marinade ingredients.
Marinade pork in marinade for 1-3 days in the refrigerator.
Cook pork on medium heat until liquid is evaporated and sugar is caramelized. Can char a little if preferred.
Serve with rice.
recipes.author: Gideon General
recipes.notes: **For Tocilog** (Tocino breakfast meal), serve with: - Garlic Fried Rice - Sukang Sawsawan (Spiced Vinegar) - Fried egg - Tomatoes (Roma preferred), chopped into small pieces

ingredients.name_text: kosher salt or 1.5 Tbsp of iodized/table salt
Optional: 15-20 drops red food color or ¼ Cup Annatto water (Add hot water to annatto seeds to extract it’s color, then get ¼ cup of it)
Pork belly or shoulder, thinly sliced

recipes.title: Sinigang incomplete
recipes.instructions:
Cook pork with water until boiling, then toss water.
Rinse/wash meat.
In a pot, boil beef on high heat while covered with salt and pepper for 1-3 hours to tenderize. Once you can poke through with a fork, cook for another 30 minutes.
In a separate pot, heat oil on medium. Add garlic and onions. Add Achuete package when hot. Add some of the beef broth from the pot.
Once boiling, add eggplant and green beans. Cook for 5-10 minutes.
Add peanut butter and mix. Can add more per preference of thickness and taste.
Add meat to pot.
Add bok choy at the end. Can add salt and pepper to taste.
Serve with shrimp paste (Bagoong)
recipes.author: Otakoyakisoba
recipes.notes: Could

recipes.title: Caramelized Ground Pork
recipes.instructions:
Heat pan on high with oil.
Add onion, ginger, garlic, and chili (Lemongrass) and cook for 2 minutes.
Add porn and cook for 2 minutes or until white all over. Break up the meat with a wooden spoon.
Add sugar and fish sauce (Lemongrass paste). Stir and leave to cook until all juices cook out and pork starts to caramelize, about 2 minutes.
Stir and leave again for around 30 seconds to get more caramelization. Repeat two more times until caramelized to taste.
Top with green onions and cilantro
Serve with white rice.
recipes.author: Recipe Tin Eats

ingredients.name_text: Thai or Birds eye chili, deseeded and minced
Optional: 1 Stalk Lemongrass, white part only finely chopped or Lemongrass paste

recipes.title: Garlic Longganisa
recipes.instructions:
Add all ingredients to a mixing bowl and mix.
Take a scoop of meat and use parchment paper to shape meat into a sausage. Continue with the rest of the meat.
Let rest overnight.
Heat oil on low. Add Longganisa without overcrowding. Flipping occasionally.
Press on the sausage, and if it is firm, it is cooked already. Then cover the pan with lid to fully cook through.
recipes.author: RV Manabat
recipes.notes: **For Longsilog** (Longganisa breakfast meal), serve with: - Garlic Fried Rice - Sukang Sawsawan (Spiced Vinegar) - Fried egg - Tomatoes (Roma preferred), chopped into small pieces

recipes.title: Mandu (Korean Dumplings)
recipes.instructions:
Add ground pork, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, and black pepper to the pan and fry until cooked. Then add sesame oil. Set aside meat.
Cook noodles in boiling water. Cool with water and chop.
Add zucchini and onions to a bowl with the salt. Allow to sit. Squeeze out excess water then stir fry in a pan with 1 Tsp oil for 1 minute.
Blanch hmong bean sprouts for 1 minute. Cool with water and squeeze out water.
Squeeze out water from tofu.
Add 1 Tsp salt, pepper, 2 tsp sesame oil. Mix all ingredients.
Put water on outer edges of dumpling wrapper, add meat, then fold into the dumpling shape.Can fry, steam, or cook in soup (hondashi or veggie stock, salt, pepper, sesame oil, egg, garlic, green onions).Cook with oil that is hot (1-2 Tbsp). Add water and cover for 4-5 min. Then remove, add more oil to fry bottom. Flip to cook other side.
recipes.author: Maanchi
recipes.notes: Can use cheesecloth to remove excess water.Thaw out dumpling wrappers night before.1 Tbsp soy sauce1 Tbsp VinegarSesame seedsHot pepper flakesGreen onions

ingredients.name_text: Alternative: Ground beef or chicken or mushrooms

recipes.title: Transporting Clams
recipes.instructions:
Once clams are in mesh back, rinse in bag in water.
Wet a towel in sea water and place in top of clams in cooler.
Do not place clams in water and do not put directly on ice.
recipes.author: Sound Fishing
recipes.notes: [Video on How to Clean Razor Clams](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GpDZhdU_g5o)

recipes.title: Cleaning Razor Clams and Frying
recipes.instructions:
Rinse clams outside to remove sand.
Boil a pot of hot water. Dump clams into hot water for 10 seconds.
Dump clams out and rinse with cold water.
Remove shells.
To clean, cut off tip of neck.
Cut along the zipper through the siphon.
Cut through second siphon.
Cut off digger through gills. Separate gut material from digger. Cut through digger to remove intestinal material.
Rinse clam and digger under water to clean.
Can store in the freezer in a bag with water for up to 6 months.
recipes.author: TheWDFW
recipes.notes: Lightly coat clam in flour and shallow fry in hot oil until a little brown. Don’t overcook otherwise it will be tough. Cook both sides. Season with salt and pepper. Can serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Clam Chowder
recipes.instructions:
If using bacon, cook on medium heat until water evaporates, pork begins to brown and crisp in spots (7-10 minutes). Remove half and place onto paper towel. Then move on to step 2.
Heat butter in a pot on moderate heat. Add onions. Mix for 3 minutes.
Add celery and 1 tsp salt. Cook for about 1 minute or until onions and celery are soft.
Add flour to the pot and mix.
Add clam juice and stir.
Add milk and bay leaves. Bring to a simmer. If using canned clams, could add here.
Heat potatoes in water in a separate pot up to a simmer. Add salt. Cook for about 8 minutes. Potatoes should be al dente.
Add potatoes to the pot and cook for another 5 minutes or until potatoes are the preferred texture.
Turn off heat and add razor clam meat. Cover the pot for 1 minute to gently poach.
Can take ¼ of soup and blend, or use a hand blender in soup until preferred consistency.
Top with quite a bit of black pepper.
Adjust with salt or fish sauce per preference.
Serve with oyster crackers, bacon, and Tabasco.
recipes.author: Kenji Lopez
recipes.notes: For richer chowder, could use ½ Cup Heavy cream in place of ½ Cup Milk.To make a corn chowder, could replace clams with corn and using chicken stock instead of clam juice.

ingredients.name_text: Optional: 4 Slices Bacon, cut into small dice
Clams or 7-8 Razor clams, cut into small dices
Russet Potato or Yukon gold potato, peeled and cut into small cubes

recipes.title: Broiled Razor Clams
recipes.instructions:
Dip cleaned clams in the egg wash.
Coat well with crushed Ritz crackers.
Lay the clams out, single layer, on a greased baking sheet. (Lining the sheet with foil first makes easier clean up)
Drizzle the clams with melted butter, more or less to taste. (Without it you’ll get dry clams)
Cooking:
Put the pan under the HOT broiler.
Broil 3 minutes. Turn over. Broil 3 more minutes, and they’re done. Avoid over-cooking or the clams get rubbery.
recipes.author: Rich D

recipes.title: Fish and Chips
recipes.instructions: **Rinse and peel russet potatoes, then cut them into 10-15mm wide fries (or however you want to make them. Fries come in all different shapes and sizes).Place the fries into a pot with room temperature oil. Slowly bring the oil up to 350°F and keep stirring them until they are golden brown. Place them on paper towels to drain the excess oil.For the beer batter, combine 1 ½ cups of all purpose flour, ½ cup of corn starch, some paprika, a pinch of kosher salt, and a few twists of freshly ground pepper.Take 1 cup of that mixture to a tray, and set aside for dredging.In the main mixture add 1 tsp of baking powder and 1 Mexican beer and whisk to combine.Take your fish, dredge it in the powder mixture, and then add it to the beer batter.Slowly add to a pot with peanut or vegetable oil at 350°F, and cook for 6-9 minutes.Remove from oil, set on a paper towel to soak up the oil and to cool off. Serve with fries and enjoy!**
recipes.author: Babish Culinary University

recipes.title: Gochugaru Salmon
recipes.instructions:
Season salmon on all sides with salt and pepper.
Cook salmon on medium-high heat with the skin side down for 2-5 minutes. ⅔ of the salmon should be coral color.
Flip salmon and cook for 1-2 minutes. If needed, can cover and cook for a few minutes to fully cook through. Transfer salmon to a plate.
Add cooked rice to the fat in the pan and spread. Reduce heat to medium and cook until the bottom is lightly browned and toasted, about 5 minutes. Flip and cook for 1-2 min. Lightly salt. Transfer rice to another plate.
In the empty pan, pour sauce mixture in and cook, stirring constantly, over medium-high heat until it bubbles up and reduces significantly, 15 sec - 1 min. It should look sticky, turn off heat and add cold butter, stirring until fully melted and incorporated.
Pour glaze over salmon and serve with cucumbers.
recipes.author: Erik Kim

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Salmon
recipes.instructions:
In a bowl, mix honey, soy sauce, and lemon juice.
Season salmon with salt, pepper, and paprika.
Heat pan on medium heat with olive oil.
Cook salmon for 3-4 minutes until golden brown.
Flip salmon and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Add butter and garlic to the pan.
Cook until slightly golden.
Add the mixture of honey, soy sauce, and lemon juice to the pan.
Spoon sauce from pan onto top of salmon to baste as it cooks.
Once finished, add green onions, chives, or parsley once to add color.
Can add sliced lemon to garnish.
recipes.author: Jerene’s Eats

recipes.title: Mayonnaise Tamarind Baked Salmon
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 325 °F.
Season salmon with salt and pepper.
Add Mayonnaise to the top of the salmon.
Top with Tamarind concentrate.
Cook salmon in the oven at 325 °F for 18-25 minutes. (125 °F internal temperature).
recipes.author: Mama Tess

recipes.title: Miso Glazed Salmon with Teriyaki Sauce
recipes.instructions:
Add miso paste, sake, soy sauce, sugar, and oil to a mixing bowl and mix.
Mix salmon in marinade. Can cook immediately or marinade for up to 2 days.
Place salmon on a foil lined tray.
Broil on high heat for 10 minutes. May vary depending on oven and thickness of salmon.
Remove salmon from the oven and let sit for a few minutes.
Glaze with Teriyaki Sauce.
Top with sesame seeds and serve with white rice.
recipes.author: Kenji Lopez-Alt
recipes.notes: Longer the marinade process, the more moist and firm the flesh will be.

ingredients.name_text: Alternatives: Red or yellow miso paste
Alternatives: broth/water with a dash of vinegar

recipes.title: Salmon Crusted with Bread Crumbs
recipes.instructions:
In a pan on medium-high heat, melt the butter.
Then add bread crumbs and toast until slightly golden brown.
Add thyme and rosemary, and cook for another 30 seconds.
Set aside bread crumbs, and season with salt and pepper.
Make a 1 part grain mustard and 1 part mayonnaise mix.
Place salmon filets onto foil coated with nonstick spray or vegetable oil. Season salmon with salt and pepper.
Coat top of salmon filets with the mustard/mayonnaise.
Add 1 egg white to the bread crumbs and mix.
Add bread crumbs to the top of the salmon.
Cook salmon in the oven at 325 °F for 18-25 minutes. (125 °F internal temperature).
Let salmon cool for 5 minutes, then serve.
recipes.author: Babish Culinary University

recipes.title: Garlic Shrimp
recipes.instructions:
Devein, peel, shrimp.
Seer shrimp on high heat with oil. Once browned, flip and brown on both sides. Repeat if multiple batches.
Lower heat. Add garlic to oil. Add seasoning.
Add shrimp and cook.
Add sauces. Increase heat.
Reduce sauce a little, stir fry.
Serve with rice
recipes.author: Pailin’s Kitchen
recipes.notes: Instead of shrimp paste, could cook head on shrimp.

ingredients.name_text: ½ Tsp Shrimp paste in oil

recipes.title: Ginger Shrimp & Glass Noodles
recipes.instructions:
Soak glass noodles in room temperature water to soften them up. Can cut noodles into smaller pieces. Drain out water.
Transfer noodles to a wide bowl and pour sauce over it. Toss noodles in sauce to coat.
Prepare shrimp by using scissors to cut off the long antenna and sharp beak. Cut through the back of the shrimp and remove the vein.
Add shrimp to the noodle bowl and toss. Let shrimp sit on the bottom of the bowl for a few minutes. Toss again and put the noodles on the bottom.
To a small pot, with lid, add black pepper, white pepper, garlic, cilantro stems, ginger, and vegetable. Mix together, then cook on high until sizzling.
Then add noodles and shrimp to the pot. Place shrimp on top of noodles.
Cover until sauce is boiling, then turn down to medium-low. Cover and cook for 3 minutes.
Stir. Squeeze shrimp heads to get shrimp fat into sauce. Cover and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Top with green onions.
Serve with rice
recipes.author: Pailin’s Kitchen
recipes.notes: Could use pork fat or pork belly instead of vegetable oil.

recipes.title: Panko Fried Shrimp
recipes.instructions:
(Optional step) Soak shrimp in water with 2 Tsp salt and 1 Tsp baking soda. Stir. Then rinse with water and pat dry.
Take 3 dredging trays and fill each with flour, eggs, and bread crumbs. To flour, can add salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, or turmeric.
Dip shrimp into flour and shake off excess. Dip into egg then into bread crumbs. Cover with a good amount of crumbs and gently press down on shrimps to ensure bread crumbs stick.
Fill the pan with enough oil to cover shrimp. Heat oil to 320-340 °F. Fry for about 2-3 minutes. Shrimp should be golden brown. Do not overcrowd the pot.
Let rest on a cooling rack.
recipes.author: Taste of Asian Food
recipes.notes: For chicken katsu, can serve with Katsu Sauce and lemon.Can serve with hardboiled egg mixed with mayonnaise.

ingredients.name_text: Shrimp, peeled and deveined with tail still on, washed

recipes.title: Tom Yum Goong (Creamy Shrimp)
recipes.instructions:
Prepare shrimp by removing the head. To devein, use a toothpick and poke under the second joint from the tail, then pull out the vein. Peel shrimp. Place heads and shell into pot.
Saute until all residual water evaporates and shrimp tamale is browning. Then deglaze with 4 cups of water and scrub the bottom of the pot. Allow to simmer for 15-20 minutes.
Fish out shrimp and add lemongrass and galangal. Crush/rip Makrut lime leaves prior to putting in to soup. Add chili. Cook for about 5 minutes. Can remove some or all herbs.
Add evaporated milk.
Add mushrooms. Cook for 1 minute.
Add fish sauce and Thai chili paste.
Add shrimp. Cook for 30 seconds and turn off heat.
Allow to cool for a minute so not building or simmering, then add lime while stirring to avoid curdling.
Add cilantro.
Turn off, add lime juice and cilantro.
recipes.author: Pailin’s Kitchen
recipes.notes: Galangal, lemon grass, and lime leaves are not edible.Chili paste in oil (Mae Ploy)

ingredients.name_text: (4 oz) Evaporated milk or coconut milk
Lemongrass, smashed then cut into 2 inch piece, use base
Or fresh chilis, mashed or finely minced

recipes.title: Spam Musubi Stir Fry
recipes.instructions:
Fry spam in a hot pan until preferred browning. Set aside.
Add mirin and stir to get flavoring that is on the pan.
Add soy sauce and sugar. Stir until sugar is melted.
Add spam back to the pan to coat in sauce.
Set aside and top with furikake and nori.
Serve over rice.
recipes.author: Junmac

ingredients.name_text: Spam, cut into bite sized pieces

recipes.title: Braised Tofu (Dubu Jorim)
recipes.instructions:
Place tofu on a sheet tray and rub 1 Tbsp soy sauce over tofu to pre-season. Leave for 10-15 minutes.
Place shiitake mushrooms into a bowl with hot water and set aside.
Add onions to a cold pan with a little bit of vegetable oil. Slowly cook to caramelize. Take about 10 minutes.
To make marinade, add to a bowl green onions, pepper, garlic, ginger, 3 Tbsp soy sauce, sesame oil, gochugaru, paprika, sugar, mirin, and sesame seeds.
Once mushrooms are soft, squeeze out the moisture into the bowl and set aside. Add mushroom liquid to the marinade bowl and mix.
Remove stems from mushrooms and slice.
Dry tofu with a paper towel.
Large pan with a lid, add vegetable oil. Heat on medium..
Add tofu to the pan. Flip to fry both sides.
Lower heat to low, add onions and mushrooms to the top of the tofu.
Top with sauce.
Turn up heat to medium, once simmering, cover for 5-10 minutes. Cook until reduced and sauce is thick.
Serve with rice.
recipes.author: Esther Choi

ingredients.name_text: Tofu, firm, cut into 1 inch thick squares

recipes.title: Crispy Baked Tofu
recipes.instructions:
To make sauce, stir together Korean chili paste, corn syrup, soy sauce, oyster sauce, garlic, and oil.
Pat dry tofu with paper towels.
Cut into tofu like a checkered pattern, but not all the way. Cut about halfway down.
Season tofu with salt and pepper. Then place onto parchment paper.
Generously brush sauce onto tofu.
In an air fryer, cook at 200 degrees C (390 degrees F) for 15 minutes. Could try 20-25 minutes in the oven.
Drizzle with sesame oil and top off with microgreens and sesame seeds.
Can serve with white rice.
recipes.author: Aaron and Claire

ingredients.name_text: Microgreens, Salad mix, or Green onions

recipes.title: Mapo Tofu (Japanese)
recipes.instructions:
Heat pan on medium-high heat with oil.
Add beef and break apart until cooked.
Add garlic, ginger, and green onions. Cook for a few minutes.
Add sake, mirin, and soy sauce. Mix.
Add tofu.
Add some cornstarch slurry to thicken the sauce. If too thick, add water. If too thin, add more slurry.
Could add some chili oil or chicken stock if preferred.
Top with chili crisp, chili garlic, or chili oil per preference.
Serve over rice.
recipes.author: Kenji Lopez Alt

ingredients.name_text: Firm Silken Tofu, sliced into small cubes
Cornstarch, with 2 tsp water to form slurry.

recipes.title: Mapo Tofu (Cantonese)
recipes.instructions:
Heat pan on medium-high heat with oil.
Add garlic, ginger, shallots, and dried chilis. Cook for 15-20 seconds.
Add pork and break apart until cooked.
Add chili bean sauce (Or Ground bean sauce).
Add 1 cup water and simmer on low.
Add light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, and salt. (Add chili sauce).
Add tofu, mix, and cover the pan for 1-2 minutes.
Add some cornstarch slurry to thicken the sauce. If too thick, add water. If too thin, add more slurry.
Finish with green onions and sesame oil.
Top with chili crisp, chili garlic, or chili oil per preference.
Serve over rice.
recipes.author: Made With Lau
recipes.notes: Can add more dark soy sauce to darken the color.Optional to add sweet peppers when adding the green onions at step 9..

ingredients.name_text: Alternatives: 1 Tbsp Ground bean sauce + 0.5 Tsp Chili sauce
Firm Silken Tofu, sliced into small cubes
Cornstarch, with 2 tsp water to form slurry.

recipes.title: Coconut Tuna Dip (Lohn pla tuna)
recipes.instructions:
In a pot, boil coconut milk and shallots on medium heat. Boil for a few minutes until reduced by half.
Add tuna, thai chilies, lemon grass, fish sauce, tamarind paste, and sugar. Mix and break up chunks of tuna. Cook on low for 2 minutes.
If too thick, can up to ¼ cup of coconut milk. Should have a dip like consistency.
Taste and adjust seasoning with fish sauce, tamarind paste, or sugar as needed.
Prior to serving, stir in cilantro.
Serve with crackers, dipping vegetables, crispy pork rind, or rice.
recipes.author: Pailin’s Kitchen (Sabai)
recipes.notes: Can garnish top with more thai chilis cilantro, and a splash of coconut milk..

ingredients.name_text: 3-inch Lemongrass, bottom half only, thinly sliced

recipes.title: Red Curry Tuna Stir Fry
recipes.instructions:
In a pan on medium low, add 2-3 Tbsp oil, curry paste, black pepper, turmeric, and palm sugar
Add tuna and stir fry until dry.
Add lime leaves and lemon grass. Toss briefly.
Taste and add fish sauce to taste.
Serve with rice.
recipes.author: Pailin’s Kitchen
recipes.notes: Can add thai chilis if preferred.

ingredients.name_text: Makrut lime leaves, thinly, could remove thick stems
Lemongrass, bottom half only, thinly sliced

recipes.title: Tuna Sisig
recipes.instructions:
Add oil from 2 canned tuna to pan, on medium heat.
Add 1 onion and saute for 20 seconds.
Add tuna and saute.
Add salt and black pepper. Mix and saute until tuna is reduced.
Add green chili peppers and mix. Continue to reduce.
Once tuna is lightly toasted and oil is reduced. Turn off the flame and set aside.
To tuna, add raw onion, mayonnaise, soy sauce, and seasoning sauce. Mix. Could add chicharon to give crunch. Or crushed Kropek. Could serve on sizzling plate. Serve with a side of calamansi juice.
recipes.author: Kuya Fern
recipes.notes: Can add red chilis if preferred.

recipes.title: Asparagus-muchim
recipes.instructions:
Blanch asparagus in boiling water for 1-2 minutes, depending on thickness. Rinse in cold water.
Add all ingredients in a mixing bowl and mix.
Can top with more sesame seeds.
recipes.author: Maangchi
recipes.notes: Prefer thin and long asparagus. Break off or cut off the tough woody bottom end of asparagus. Can use these ends for vegetable stock. Can peel if thick pieces.

ingredients.name_text: Alternative: Honey, Corn syrup, or Sugar

recipes.title: Braised Asparagus
recipes.instructions:
Sear asparagus in neutral oil or olive oil. Season with salt and pepper.
Sear until lightly browned per preference. Flip.
Add butter and vegetable stock and cover.
Cook for a few minutes. Uncover and continue to cook to reduce into a glaze. Should not be too watery, if it starts to look greasy, then you reduced too much.
recipes.author: Kenji Lopez
recipes.notes: Prefer thin and long asparagus. Break off or cut off the tough woody bottom end of asparagus. Can use these ends for vegetable stock. Can peel if thick pieces.

recipes.title: Avocado Cilantro Dressing
recipes.instructions:
Blend all ingredients in a food processor or a blender.
Add ½ cup water and blend again.
recipes.author: Hobby and Cook
recipes.notes: Store for up to 1 week.If you want it thicker, add less water.Could add some oil if preferred.Could add pepper for spice.Can add boiled or roasted onions and jalapeno to make a salsa.

recipes.title: Avocado Korean Salad and Avocado Sashimi
recipes.instructions:
For Korean salad, mix all ingredients, adding lettuce last.
For Sashimi, serve with all ingredients.

recipes.title: Avocado Toast
recipes.instructions:
Lightly season bread with salt and pepper. Add a touch of olive oil to both sides and toast both sides on a pan.
Place avocado slices onto bread and either flute out or crush per preference.
Top with preferred toppings. **Toppings**1. Kylie Jenner - honey, chili flakes, salt
Gordon Ramsay - lemon juice, black sesame seeds, chili flakes, lemon zest, salt, pepper
Joshua Weissman
- Plain Jane - salt, pepper, olive oil
- New Yorker - smoked salmon, red onion thinly sliced, tomato slices, capers
- Egg - soft boiled egg (6.5 minutes) cut in half, salt, parmesan cheese
- Samurai - togarashi powder, salt
Bobby Flay
- green onions, shallots, cilantro, lime juice, egg salad
- Green onions, cilantro, lime juice, smoked salmon
Lemon juice, salt, pepper, black sesame seeds, white sesame seeds, poppy seeds, garlic and onion dehydrated
recipes.notes: Lemon juice prevents avocado from browning.

recipes.title: Refried Beans
recipes.instructions:
Boil water in a pot and add the quarters of onion, garlic, salt, and pinto beans
Cook on low heat for 2-3 hours, until beans have a mushy soft consistency.
In a pan, heat oil and add finely chopped onions and peppers. Cook until onions are soft and translucent, but make sure to not burn.
Ladle beans in with juice and all. Smash the beans with a masher until preferred consistency. Add salt to taste. Can add cheese on top if preferred.
recipes.author: Views on the Road
recipes.notes: Can serve with Carnitas and Salsa or Al Pastor Tacos.

ingredients.name_text: Jalapeno or serrano pepper, finely chopped

recipes.title: Bok Choy Pork Soup
recipes.instructions:
Marinate meat with cornstarch, oyster sauce, and 1 Tbsp water.
On high heat, add 2 Cups water and chicken broth to a pot.
Add ginger, salt, and vegetable oil to the pot.
Once boiling, add stalks first, then add leaves.
Cover with lid and return to gentle boil (Takes 3-5 minutes usually).
Add pork to the pot.
Add Knorr chicken powder or Chicken bouillon to the pot.
Cook for about 1-2 minutes until the soup is boiling again.
Can remove bok choy and pork from soup and serve separate from soup.
Finish soup with green onion and black pepper.
recipes.author: Made With Lau
recipes.notes: For soups, use 3-4 outer leaves of bok choy. Use the inner leaves for stir fry as they are tougher. Store bok choy by wrapping the inside of the bag with a paper towel and poke holes in the bag for longer storage up to a week.Can season with fish oil, soy sauce, sriracha, and sesame oil per preference.

ingredients.name_text: Cube of Knorr Chicken powder or ½ Tsp Chicken bouillon
Pork chops or Pork belly,, thinly sliced
Bok choy, stems separated from leaves

recipes.title: Brussels Sprouts
recipes.instructions:
Blanch brussels sprouts in boiling water with salt for 6-7 minutes.
Strain and let steam for 2 minutes.
Place in bowl with a bit olive oil and salt, toss.
On a sheet pan, add more olive oil, place sprouts flesh side down spaced apart.
Bake 400 degrees F for 25-30 minutes.
recipes.author: ThatDudeCanCook

ingredients.name_text: Brussels sprouts, trimmed and sliced vertically

recipes.title: Maple Fish Sauce Brussels Sprouts
recipes.instructions:
Add garlic oil or cooking oil to the pan.
Add brussels sprouts flat side down.
Heat on medium high until well browned on the bottom side.
Then toss or flip the sprouts to cook on the other side. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
If there are extra sprouts to cook, turn off heat, remove brussels sprouts and cook the second batch of sprouts.
Put all the sprouts back in the pan with heat off.
Add fish sauce, maple syrup, and pepper. Mix to coat evenly..
Can serve at room temperature or hot.
Optional to top with crispy garlic or garlic powder.
recipes.author: Pailin’s Kitchen

ingredients.name_text: Optional: Crispy Garlic or Garlic powder
Brussel sprouts, trimmed and sliced vertically

recipes.title: Carrot Fries
recipes.instructions: Toss all ingredients on a baking sheet and bake at 400 degrees F for 15-20 minutes.
recipes.author: Tasty
recipes.notes: Can serve with Greek Yogurt Dip or Cheese Sauce.Could toss with cumin, parsley, paprika.

recipes.title: Creamy Carrot Soup
recipes.instructions:
Saute onions and garlic in pot with butter/oil for about 5 minutes until onions are soft and turning translucent. Season onions with salt.
Add thai red curry paste and cook for about 1 minute.
Add in carrots and vegetable broth.
Once boiling, reduce to medium low and simmer for about 20 minutes until carrots are tender.
Puree soup via blender or use an immersion blender until smooth.
Pour in heavy cream and stir.
Season with salt and pepper.
recipes.author: The Stay At Home Chef and RecipeTin
recipes.notes: Could top with thyme, pepper, parsley, sour cream, bacon, or dill.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Pickled Carrots
recipes.instructions:
Cover carrots with sugar and salt, mix, and rest for at least 5 minutes (Longer for thicker slices). Carrots are ready when bendable without snapping.
Boil water with vinegar, sugar, and salt.
Add hot mixture and carrots to a jar.
recipes.author: Gaming Foodie
recipes.notes: Could try adding cumin or serrano peppers.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Pickled Carrots and Daikon
recipes.instructions:
Place carrots and daikon into bowl. Add 1 Tbsp Sugar and mix and let for a couple of minutes . ½ Tbsp salt for a minute. Let sit for 5 minute until bendable. Wash for 3 minutes.
Shake off excess water and squeeze.
Into a container.
3 Cups of warm water into bowl. 4 Tbsp sugar. 5 Tbsp rice vinegar or distilled vinegar. Mix until dissolved. Add sliced thai chilis per preference. Add to daikon and carrots.
Store for 2-3 days. Good in the fridge for up to 1 month.
recipes.author: Tasty Like Whoa
recipes.notes: Could try adding cumin or serrano peppers.

ingredients.name_text: Medium sized carrots, sliced into matchsticks

recipes.title: Roasted Cauliflower
recipes.instructions:
Place cauliflower onto a sheet pan and drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle generously with salt and pepper. Toss well.
Bake in oven at 350 degrees F for 30 minutes until tender and starts to brown. Toss once at 15 minute mark.
Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and honey and bake for 2 more minutes until cheese melts.
Season to taste.
Can top with chopped parsley

ingredients.name_text: Cauliflower head, cut into bite size florets
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper

recipes.title: Spanish Garlic Cauliflower
recipes.instructions:
Heat pot with water and salt until boiling.
Add cauliflower florets and cook for 4-6 minutes. Cauliflower can be easily pierced with a toothpick.
Drain cauliflower and set aside.
Heat pan on low-medium heat with olive oil.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add paprika, mix, then add florets.
Season with salt and pepper. Mix to coat.
Transfer to serving dish and sprinkle with parsley.
recipes.author: Spain on a Fork

ingredients.name_text: Cauliflower head, cut into bite size florets (~25 florets)

recipes.title: Corn Chowder
recipes.instructions:
To a pot, add corn cobs, chicken stock, bay leaves, coriander seeds, black peppercorns, and fennel seeds. Bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Strain and discard cobs and spices. Set aside corn stock.
If using bacon, cook pot on medium heat until water evaporates, pork begins to brown and crisp in spots (7-10 minutes). Remove half and place onto a paper towel. Then move on to step 3.
Heat butter in a pot on moderate heat. Add corn kernels, celery, onions, and garlic. Mix for 7 minutes until corn kernels are soft.
Add flour to the pot and mix for 1 minute..
Stir while slowly adding corn stock.
Add potatoes and 1 Tsp salt.
Stir occasionally and simmer for 10 minutes, until potatoes are tender.
Add milk and stir.
Can take ¼ of soup and blend, or use a hand blender in soup until preferred consistency.
Season with salt, pepper, and sugar.
Top with green onions.
recipes.author: Kenji Lopez
recipes.notes: Once chilled, can whisk in water 1 tbsp at a time until preferred consistency.Younger corn does not require as much sugar added.

ingredients.name_text: Husks Corn, kennels sliced off and scraped off, cobs cut in half
Optional: 4 Slices Bacon, cut into small dice
Whole Milk or Half and Half
Russet Potato or Yukon gold potato, peeled and cut into small cubes

recipes.title: Dill Pickles
recipes.instructions:
Add cucumbers to a jar.
Add peppercorn, mustard seeds, coriander seeds, and dill seed/weed to a cheese cloth to make a satchel.
Add water, vinegar, salt, bay leaves, turmeric, and satchel to a pot, then bring to a boil.
Pour hot mixture into jar with cucumbers.
Add fresh dill and garlic to jar.
Allow to cool. Store in the refrigerator.
recipes.author: Joshua Weissman
recipes.notes: Can be used with Hamburgers.

recipes.title: Korean Pickled Cucumbers
recipes.instructions:
Add vegetables to the jar.
To a pot, add soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and water. Cook until boiling and boil for 10 seconds.
Turn off heat and pour hot mixture into the jar. Do not fill all the way to the top as water can come out of vegetables.
Let sit and cool and store in the refrigerator over night.l.
recipes.author: Future Neighbor
recipes.notes: Could try adding cumin to pickling jar.

ingredients.name_text: Korean chili pepper (Cheongyang) or Jalapeno, sliced or minced

recipes.title: Marinated Cucumber, Onion, and Tomato Salad
recipes.instructions: Whisk sugar, vinegar, salt, and oil into a mixing bowl. Thenn add the rest of the ingredients and toss. Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour. Can store for 2-3 days.

recipes.title: Pickled Cucumbers
recipes.instructions:
Cover cucumbers with sugar and salt, mix, and rest for at least 20 minutes, until they can bend without snapping. Drain out excess water.
Boil water with vinegar, sugar, and salt.
Add hot pickling mixture and cucumbers to a jar.
recipes.author: Gaming Foodie
recipes.notes: Can serve with sesame oil, sesame seeds, and gochugaru.Could try adding cumin or serrano peppers to pickling jar.Could try without salt.

recipes.title: Pickled Cucumbers
recipes.instructions:
Cover cucumbers with 3 tsp salt, mix, and rest for at least 20 minutes, until they can bend without snapping. Drain out excess water.
Boil water with vinegar and sugar.
Add hot pickling mixture and cucumbers to a jar.
recipes.author: Derrick
recipes.notes: Can serve with sesame oil, sesame seeds, and gochugaru.Could try adding cumin or serrano peppers to pickling jar.

recipes.title: Braised Daikon
recipes.instructions:
Simmer daikon in pot with 1 Tbsp of rice or some rice water (Optional). Cover daikon by ½-1 inch of water. Simmer for at least 30 minutes. The rice helps remove the daikon smell. Can taste liquid which is bitter. Chipstick should easily go into daikon and it can slide off.
Take out daikon. Empty pot.
In pot with oil on medium, add ginger, garlic, green onion, and sichuan peppercorns until fragrant.
Carefully add cold water (2 Cups) into pot, add sauces.
Once boiling, add daikon and simmer for 30 minutes uncovered.
recipes.author: Lucas Sin

ingredients.name_text: Daikon, peeled and sliced into 1-2 inch chunks
Green onions, sliced into 2 inch pieces

recipes.title: Daikon Steak
recipes.instructions:
Peel skin of daikon and save skins. Score top and bottom of daikon with knife. Can peel to curve edges.
Salt the daikon.
To a bowl, add the daikin skins, chicken bouillon, hondashi 0.85 Cups water. Cover with paper towel.
Microwave for 10 minutes with 600w microwave.
Remove daikon and filter liquid for use later.
Make garlic oil and filter out garlic crips.
Cook daikon in a Tbsp of garlic oil until browned on bot sides.
Add a bit of butter.
Add some of broth prepared earlier. Cook to boil, cover and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Can flip and baste.
Add garlic chips.
Plate and top with parsley, black pepper, and the sauce in pan.
recipes.author: Maanchi
recipes.notes: Can cook in pot instead of microwave.

recipes.title: Pickled Radish
recipes.instructions:
Add sugar, vinegar, salt, and water to mixing bowl and mix to dissolve.
Add radish, mix, and store in container.
Refrigerate for a couple of hours. Taste better after 12 hours.
recipes.author: Maanchi

ingredients.name_text: Daikon or Korean radish, peeled and cut into small ½ inch cubes

recipes.title: Radish Rice (Mu-bap)
recipes.instructions:
Rinse rice in water and soak for 30 minutes.
In rice cooker, put half of radish on bottom, then add rice. Add 1 cup water. Top with left over radish. Cook.
Prepare sauce by mixing ingredients.
Mix rice and radish.
When serving, can add in sauce to a bowl of rice and mix as preferred.
recipes.author: Maanchi
recipes.notes: Can eat with mushroom bulgogi.

recipes.title: Garlic Green Beans
recipes.instructions:
