Ensure green beans are dried with paper towel.
Heat up enough oil to deep fry green beans (~300 degrees).
Fry for 1-3 minutes until skin is blistered.
Save oil for another recipe.
Fry garlic in pan oil until slightly brown.
Add in green beans. Mix and season with salt.
recipes.author: Future Neighbor
recipes.notes: Can add chili oil or gochugaru for some spicy.

ingredients.name_text: Green beans, sliced into 3 inch pieces

recipes.title: Mung Bean Sprout Side (Sukjunamul-muchim)
recipes.instructions:
Blanch the mung bean sprouts it boiling water for 1 minutes.
Remove and place into cold water immediately to keep crispiness.
Mix and rinse with hands, grab and shake to remove skins.
In a mixing bowl add all ingredients and mix.
recipes.author: Maangchi

recipes.title: Mung Bean Sprout Stir Fry
recipes.instructions:
Blanch the mung bean sprouts it boiling water for 1 minutes.
Remove and place into cold water immediately to keep crispiness.
Mix and rinse with hands, grab and shake to remove skins.
In a mixing bowl add all ingredients and mix.
recipes.author: Delicious food

recipes.title: Boiled Soy Sauce Mushrooms
recipes.instructions:
Heat pot with water until boiling.
Add mushrooms and reduce to medium heat.
Cook until all water is evaporated.
Add some neutral oil and saute for 2-3 minutes.
Add soy sauce and saute for 1 minute.
recipes.notes: After step 3, boiled mushrooms can be used in the Stir Fry Sauce recipe.

recipes.title: Bulgogi King Oyster Mushrooms
recipes.instructions:
Combine all ingredients and mix. Can marinate if preferred.
Grill mushrooms until cooked on both sides until soft. While cooking, pour the extra sauce over.
recipes.author: Maangchi

ingredients.name_text: Large King Oyster Mushrooms, thinly sliced

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Mushrooms
recipes.instructions:
Heat pan on high heat and oil.
Add mushrooms and stir-fry until deeply browned and crisp in spots, but still juicy and tender. About 5 minutes. Reduce heat if mushrooms threaten to burn. Add butter in the middle of cooking.
Add garlic and cook until fragrant. About 15 seconds.
Add thyme and parsley
Add Mirin and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper.
Toss until mushrooms are thoroughly coated.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

ingredients.name_text: Mushrooms (Shiitake, button, or cremini), trimmed and cut into quarters
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper

recipes.title: Soy-Glazed Mushrooms
recipes.instructions:
Heat pan on high heat and add oil.
Add mushrooms and stir-fry until deeply browned and crisp in spots, but still juicy and tender. About 5 minutes. Reduce heat if mushrooms threaten to burn.
Add garlic and ginger (and optional chili peppers), and cook until fragrant. About 15 seconds.
Add soy sauce (and optional oyster sauce) and toss to combine.
Add sugar, sesame oil, green onions, and sesame seeds. Toss until mushrooms are thoroughly coated.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
recipes.author: Kenji-Lopez Alt
recipes.notes: Can be stored in the refrigerator for up to a week.Can be added to salads, soups, or other stir fries. **Add chicken:**1-2 Chicken breasts/thighs, sliced into bite size pieces.Prior to step 1, cook chicken on medium heat with oil until golden. Then cover and cook on low heat for 3 minutes. Set aside and add chicken after step 2. Increase the amount of ingredients in next steps to match serving. Can add 1 Tbsp cornstarch + 2 Tbsp water slurry to make the sauce more thick. **Add Bok choy:**Prior to step 1, add water to the pan on medium and add bok choy. Cover for a minute. Stir and cook for another minute. Set aside, and re add after step 3. Can add 1 Tbsp cornstarch + 2 Tbsp water slurry to make the sauce more thick.

ingredients.name_text: Mushrooms (Shiitake, button, or cremini), trimmed and cut into quarters
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper

recipes.title: Blanched Chinese Lettuce
recipes.instructions:
Add ~5 Cups water to a pot and heat to boil. Add pinch of salt.
Rinse lettuce.
To make sauce, add 1 Tbsp oil to a pan on high heat.
Add garlic to the pan and saute for 2 minutes.
To the pan, add a pinch of salt, oyster sauce, soy sauce, and 3 Tbsp of water. Mix to make sauce and turn off heat.
Blanch romaine lettuce in boiling water for 20 seconds. This wilts the lettuce while retaining crispness.
Plate lettuce and pour sauce over.
Serve right away to avoid lettuce getting too soft.
recipes.author: Kenji Lopez-Alt

recipes.title: Korean Lettuce Salad
recipes.instructions:
Wash and drain lettuce. Shake lettuce to remove excess water.
Tear lettuce into bite size pieces and set aside.
Combine rest of ingredients into large mixing bowl. Mix well until sugar is dissolved.
Can quickly cook green onion and onion in a pan prior to adding in if preferred.
Add lettuce and mix gently to coat.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve right away as a side dish for rice.
recipes.author: Maangchi

ingredients.name_text: Korean hot pepper flakes/Gochugaru (or 1 Tbsp Gochujang/chili paste)

recipes.title: Spinach Side Dish (Sigeumchi-namul)
recipes.instructions:
Blanch spinach in boiling water for 30-60 seconds.
Wash spinach a couple of times to remove any dirt.
Squeeze out water into a ball. Cut spinach ball into 4 pieces.
Add the rest of the ingredients and mix.
recipes.author: Maangchi

recipes.title: Bread Crumb Parmesan Roasted Squash
recipes.instructions:
Coat squash in olive oil, then coat with all ingredients.
Place on baking sheet and sprinkle with some olive oil/
Bake in oven at 370 degrees for 25 minutes. **Could also work with eggplant, zucchini, bell pepper, potatoes**
recipes.author: Kenji Lopez-Alt

recipes.title: No Knead Bread in Dutch Oven
recipes.instructions:
Mix warm water with yeast. Set aside for 5 minutes. Expect bubbles to form if yeast is good.
Mix flour and salt. Add yeasty water. Mix well with spatula.
Leave dough in bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Let sit for 8-12 hours at room temperature (Not to exceed 18 hours). It will become bubbly and will increase in size.
Transfer dough on a well-floured surface. Sprinkle some flour on the dough. Using scraper, fold dough over a couple of times. Line bowl with parchment paper and put the dough back. Slit lines on top of the dough (Can make designs). Cover and let sit white preheating oven.
Preheat oven to 450C
When oven is ready, move the parchment paper with the dough into dutch oven.
Bake covered for 30 minutes.
Remove paper then continue baking uncovered for 10-15 minutes to make crust crispy.
Cool on a rack to let the middle of the break bake completely.
recipes.author: Liza S.

recipes.title: Pandesal
recipes.instructions:
Into a mixing bowl, add milk, butter, egg, and yeast. Mix ingredients a little.
Add flour, sugar, and salt. Mix until combined.
Let rest uncovered for 20 minutes.
Sprinkle some flour onto a clean surface and transfer dough to it.
Knead until dough is smooth for about 7 minutes.
Form into a ball and place into an oiled bowl. Get some oil on the ball.
Cover with saran wrap for an hour or until dough doubles in size.
Push onto dough to remove gas, then place onto surface and cut into 18 pieces.
Form each into a ball, pinch the seams to seal.
Roll under palm to smoothen balls.
Dredge balls into bread crumbs and place onto baking sheet.
Cover with saran wrap and let rest in a warm place until doubled in size.
Bake at 180 degrees C (350 degrees F) for 18-20 minutes.
recipes.author: Savor Easy
recipes.notes: Can serve with sugar and butter, toasted.

recipes.title: Garlic Fried Rice
recipes.instructions:
Cook pan on medium heat with oil.
Add garlic and saute for 1 minute.
Steam rice with some water in the microwave. Ensure rice is not stuck together.
Add rice to the pan and mix.
Add salt, pepper, and garlic powder to taste and mix.
Saute for about 3 minutes.
recipes.author: Gideon General
recipes.notes: Can serve with Tocino.

recipes.title: Ginger Egg Fried Rice
recipes.instructions:
Cook rice.
Cut chicken into thin strips, then into small bits. Marinate with 0.5 Tsp salt, 1 Tsp cornstarch, 2 Tbsp water. Mix and massage until marinade is fully absorbed, then mince.
Add ½ tsp salt to eggs, mix eggs.
Heat pan on high, then add 1-2 Tbsp oil.
Add eggs to the pan and constantly stir for 45-50 seconds. Nice soft consistency, place eggs on the side for later.
Add another 1-2 Tbsp of oil. Cook chicken in the pan for about 60 seconds.
Add ginger and stir fry for about 1 minute.
Add rice and cook for about 60 seconds. Spreading rice.
Add salt and stir.
Add egg and mix for about 2 minutes.
Add green onion and mix.
recipes.author: Cooking with Lau
recipes.notes: Can prepare without ginger to make Egg Fried Rice. Chicken is optional.

ingredients.name_text: Chicken breast (Alternatives: shrimp, pork, carrots, radishes, broccoli, corn)
salt (or 1 Tbsp soy sauce, oyster sauce, chicken stock, chicken bouillon powder, to taste)

recipes.title: Kimchi Fried Rice
recipes.instructions:
Heat pan on medium heat with oil.
Add bacon or beef and cook for 30 seconds.
Add green onions, push everything to one side and into empty space add soy sauce. Wait for a bit and then mix all together.
Add kimchi and stir to combine.
Add Korean chili pepper flakes and mix.
Add sugar and stir fry for at least 3 minutes.
Steam rice with some water in the microwave. Ensure rice is not stuck together.
Add rice and mix everything together. Make sure not to burn it by either turning off heat or add 1 Tbsp of water.
Add cooked egg on top. Top with sesame seeds and more green onions.

ingredients.name_text: Optional: 1 slice bacon, or thin beef, finely chopped
Kimchi, cut into bite sized pieces

recipes.title: Masala Fried Rice
recipes.instructions:
Coat rice with spices.
Heat pan on medium heat with oil.
Add potatoes and cook until golden color for about 5 minutes.
Add onions and salt.
Add garlic and dried chili.
Add rice.

recipes.title: Mushroom Fried Rice
recipes.instructions:
Heat up a nonstick pan on medium heat.
Saute mushrooms, dry for 5-8 minutes.
Add olive oil, green onions, and rice.
Add soy sauce and saute for 2-3 minutes.
Plate the fried rice and sprinkle it with sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Kimchi Jeon (Fritter)
recipes.instructions:
Add all dry ingredients to a mixing bowl and mix.
Add water little by little without overmixing. Consistency should be very loose and resemble vomit.
If using a stainless steel pan, heat the pan until very hot and add 3 Tbsp oil to well coat.
Add batter and flatten.
Once the edges are cooked, flip the fritter.
Cook until both sides are done.
recipes.author: Doobdobap
recipes.notes: **Serve with sauce:** - 1 Tbsp soy sauce - 1 Tbsp Vinegar - Sesame seeds - Hot pepper flakes - Green onions

recipes.title: Scallion Pancakes
recipes.instructions:
Add flour to a mixing bowl and add ½ cup of hot water. Mix.
Add in ¼ cup room temperature water. Mix.
Add in sugar and salt. Mix.
Knead dough until no more flour on side of bowl. Then knead on a cutting board for at least 100 times. Cover with a towel and let rest for 20-30 minutes.
Slice scallions, using mainly green portions.
To make roux, in a pan add flour and oil on medium heat, stir to combine. Cook until mixed.
Dust flour onto cutting board. Roll dough into cylinder and divide per preference (4-5 pieces).
Roll dough until thin. Paint on the roux onto dough. Cover with scallions.
Can add 5-spice powder here.
Roll dough over to cover scallions in. Then roll dough into itself again to form a pinwheel. Pinch dough together. Continue with other pieces.
Roll dough out as much as possible.
Add generous amount of oil into pan and add flattened dough.
Fry until golden brown. Then flip. Can squish while cooking to add fluff.
recipes.notes: Can store flattened dough in the freezer.

recipes.title: Scallion Pancakes
recipes.instructions:
Add flour to a mixing bowl and add ½ cup of hot water. Mix.
Add in 1/2 cup room temperature water. Mix. If dough is too sticky, add a Tbsp of flour. Let rest for up to 10 minutes, covered. Divide dough into 2 pieces.
Roll dough on a flour covered surface. Roll into 8-inch circle.
Sprinkle with salt, MSG, and five spice. Roll with rolling pin so spices stick to dough.
Drizzle with sesame oil and sprink;e with scallions.
Roll dough into a log, flatten slightly, and coil into a circle. Roll out into 8 inch circle again.
Repeat with other dough.
Heat 2 Tbsp oil on medium. Cook pancake, covered and flipping once until golden and crispy. 4-5 minutes per pancake. Repeat with other pancake.
Can mix sweet bean paste and yellow bean paste for sauce.
Cut into wedges and serve.
recipes.notes: Can store flattened dough in the freezer.

recipes.title: French Toast
recipes.instructions:
Add eggs, milk, sugar, and vanilla extract to mixing bowl, and mix with whisk.
Soak bread slice into custard mixture. Can let sit in custard for a while.
Add salted butter to griddle or pan and heat.
Add toast.
Can spoon over some custard onto bread.
Cook at least 4 minutes per side.
Serve with butter and syrup. Could add cinnamon or powdered sugar.
recipes.notes: For a crispier crust, can add sprinkle of sugar on one side before flipping.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pancakes
recipes.instructions:
In a mixing bowl, add flour, salt, sugar, and baking powder.
In another container mix buttermilk, vanilla extract, egg, and butter. Add to dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Do not overmix.
Butter the pan on medium.
Add batter to pan and cook batter.
recipes.notes: For a crispier crust, can add sprinkle of sugar on one side before flipping. 1 Egg, 1.5 Cups whole milk, whisk. 2 Cups all purpose flour. ¼ Cup sugar, 1 Tsp salt, ¼ Tsp Baking soda, 1 Tbsp Baking powder2 Tbsp melted butterCook 3-4 min.

recipes.title: Crispy Oven Baked French Fries
recipes.instructions:
Set pot of water to boil.
Preheat oven to 450 degrees.
Peel and slice potato. First square off potato, then slice into about ½ inch sheets and then into ½ inch fries, or preference.
Add vinegar and salt to boiling water.
Add potatoes to pot and cook for 8 minutes with occasional stirring.
Strain fries into strainer.
Add to baking sheet and pour olive oil over potatoes. Mix to coat.
Add baking sheet to oven and cook for about 35 minutes. Flipping halfway through. Can cook longer if not crispy.
Add fries to a bowl with paper towel and add a pinch of salt. Mix then remove paper towel.
Could season with preferred seasoning.
recipes.author: Ethan Chlebowski

recipes.title: Chili Garlic Noodles
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil to 350 degrees F.
To a heat resistance bowl, add the rest of the ingredients. Pour hot oil over mixture.
Boil noodle according to directions. Drain and toss with chili oill.
Top with green onions,
recipes.author: Joshua Weissman
recipes.notes: Could serve with protein, such as tofu or chicken.

ingredients.name_text: Noodles (Egg noodles, ramen noodles, wheat noodles, any asian)

recipes.title: Filipino Spaghetti
recipes.instructions:
Boil 4 cups of water in a pot at high, add 1 Tbsp salt. Boil for 11 minutes until soft. Pour into a colander and save pasta water. Can wash pasta to stop it from cooking further.
Cook mushrooms on high medium heat with oil for a few minutes, then set aside.
On medium heat, cook olive oil.
Add onions and garlic to the pan.
Add beef, tomato paste and oyster sauce
Cook until meat is cooked, 5-10 minutes,
Add sugar, salt, black pepper. Can add sugar, salt, pepper here.
Add mushrooms, hotdogs, tomato/pasta sauce, and Jufran.
Mix and cook until boiling. Let simmer for 3-5 minutes. Can thicken with pasta water if needed.
Add cheese, mix, and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Serve cooked sauce over noodles.

ingredients.name_text: Salt, Black pepper, Sugar, to taste
Pcs Hotdogs or 1 can vienna sausage or spam, sliced

recipes.title: Gochujang Noodle Soup
recipes.instructions:
On medium heat, cook oil.
Add beef and saute for 1-2 minutes, until no longer pink.
Add ½ Tbsp soy sauce and 1 Tsp sugar, a few shakes of black pepper. Mix and cook for 1 minute.
Reduce to low heat, add green onion whites, 1 Tbsp minced garlic, 3 Tbsp Gochujang, 1 Tbsp korean soy bean paste, 1 Tbsp gochugaru. Stir fry for 3 minutes.
Once you can see some chili oil, add 6 cups of water and bring to a boil on medium-high heat.
Then add potatoes and mushrooms. Add 1 Tbsp chicken bouillon or beef bouillon.
Add ¼ Tsp MSG.
Add onion and noodles or follow package instructions.
Add zucchini at the end.
Can add spicy chili pepper at the end.
Can top with green onions, sesame seeds, and toasted seaweed.
recipes.author: Aaron and Claire

recipes.title: Shanghai-Style Noodles with Scallion Oil
recipes.instructions:
Cook noodles according to package directions.
Rinse the noodles briefly under cold water when they are done to stop cooking.
To a pan, add the scallion oil, light and dark soy sauce, and sugar to noodles and cook on high heat until the sugar has dissolved and the sauce is shimmering.
Add the noodles to the pan, toss to coat in the sauce, and cook until just heated through.
Can top with more fried scallions from scallion oil if preferred.
recipes.author: Kenji Lopez-Alt

ingredients.name_text: Portions of Noodles (Fresh wheat, spaghetti, or dry wheat)

recipes.title: Pad See Ew
recipes.instructions:
Combine sauce ingredients and stir to mix.
Heat pan with oil on high heat, add garlic and cook for 15 seconds. Add protein and cook until mostly cooked.
Add Chinese broccoli stems and cook until protein is cooked through
Add Chinese broccoli leaves and cook until just wilted.
Push everything to one side and crack eggs and scramble.
Remove everything and set aside.
Clean the pan with a paper towel to remove excess liquid.
Heat the pan with oil on high heat until smoking hot.
Add Ho Fun noodles and sauce..
Toss as few times as possible to disperse sauce and make edges of noodles caramelized. About 1-1½ minutes.
Quickly add protein and vegetables back in and toss to disperse.
Serve immediately. ?Try spice? Gochujang? gochugaru?
recipes.author: Pailin’s Kitchen

ingredients.name_text: (6 oz) Beef or protein of choice, thinly sliced (6-7 slices of costco thinly sliced beef)
(450 g) Ho Fun Noodles (Fresh wide rice noodles)

recipes.title: Pancit Bihon Guisado
recipes.instructions:
In a wok, lightly toast carrots on medium heat with oil. Then set aside.
Saute chopped onions on high for about 20 seconds.
Add garlic and saute for another 10 seconds.
Add chicken and let fat render.
Add salt, black pepper, oyster sauce, and soy sauce. Mix and reduce on high heat.
Add chicken liver to add extra flavor (Optional). Continue to reduce.
Add 7 cups of hot water.
Mix and slow cook for about 5 minutes.
Separate/strain meat from broth. Set aside meat.
Add bihon noodles and cook on low to medium to let noodles absorb flavors of broth.
Can set some broth aside in case it is too much.
Cook until broth is completely absorbed by noodles.
Can readd broth if needed.
Add carrots, chicken, and chopped cabbage. Turn off heat and mix thoroughly.
recipes.author: Kuya Fern

ingredients.name_text: Chicken thigh or breast, chopped into small pieces
Optional: 4 Piece Chicken liver, sliced into small pieces

recipes.title: Radish Rice with Korean Sauce
recipes.instructions:
Place half of the radish into the rice cooker.
Add rice, then top with the rest of the radish.
Add 1 cup of water, and start the rice cooker.
Serve rice with some sauce mixed in.
recipes.author: Maangchi
recipes.notes: Sauce can be served with regular rice as well.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot or dutch oven. Add rice and mix. Continue to stir until browned evenly.
Add tomato sauce and Spice mix.
Add chicken broth and ½ cup water, then mix.
Lower heat to a simmer and cover for about 10-15 minutes. Ensure that rice does not burn or dry out.
Turn off heat when just a little liquid is left. Leave lid on and allow pot to sit to continue cooking after the heat is turned off. Rice should be nice and fluffy when ready, not sticky. Mix when ready.
recipes.author: ArnieTex
recipes.notes: Can serve with Carnitas and Salsa or Al Pastor Tacos.

recipes.title: Buffalo Sauce
recipes.instructions:
In a pan, melt butter on medium heat.
Add garlic.
One bubbles form, add the hot sauce. Mix and turn off heat.
recipes.author: Kenji Lopez-Alt
recipes.notes: The longer it is cooked, the sweeter the sauce may get due to Garlic. Or browning garlic. Can serve on Baked Buffalo Chicken Wings.

ingredients.name_text: Frank’s Red Hot Sauce or Crystal Hot Sauce (Try more Tbsp)

recipes.title: Honey BBQ Buffalo Sauce
recipes.instructions:
In a pan, melt butter on medium heat.
Add garlic.
One bubbles form, add the other ingredients. Cook to caramelize sauce. Mix and turn off heat.
recipes.author: Kuya Fern
recipes.notes: Can serve on Baked Buffalo Chicken Wings.

ingredients.name_text: Frank’s Red Hot Sauce or Crystal Hot Sauce (Try more Tbsp)

recipes.title: Honey Sriracha Sauce
recipes.instructions: Mix all ingredients
recipes.author: Food Wishes
recipes.notes: Can serve on Baked Honey Sriracha Wings.

recipes.title: Stir Fry Sauce
recipes.instructions:
Mix ingredients in a jar and shake to combine. Store in refrigerator and shake before use.
Heat 2 Tbsp oil on high heat in pan.
Add base flavoring of choice (garlic, ginger, dried chili peppers, shallots) and fry for 10 seconds.
Add stir fry ingredients in order of time to cook (starting with ingredients that take longest to cook), leaving leafy greens, like leaves of bok choy, until when you add the sauce (otherwise they will wilt and overcook).
Add noodles (if using), sauce and water (amounts below), choice of additional flavorings and any leafy greens.
Gently toss to combine and let sauce cook for around 1 minutes. Sauce will become thick and glossy and coats stir fry.
Serve over rice.**
****Amount to Use** - ****Stir Fry:****
- 3 Tbsp Stir Fry Sauce + 6 Tbsp Water + 5 Cups Uncooked ingredients
- ****Noodles:****
- 3 Tbsp Stir Fry Sauce + 6 Tbsp Water + 7 Cups Uncooked ingredients
- ****By Weight:****
- 3 Tbsp Stir Fry Sauce per 1 lb/500 g Uncooked ingredients

Light Soy Sauce0.5 Cup Oyster Sauce

recipes.title: Teriyaki Sauce
recipes.instructions:
Add ingredients to pan and cook down to reduce into a syrup.
Can add garlic and ginger for flavor while cooking.
recipes.author: Kenji Lopez-Alt
recipes.notes: Alternative ingredients: - 2 Parts Sugar - 2 Parts Sake - 1 Part Soy sauce Can serve with Miso Glazed Salmon

recipes.title: Sesame Dressing
recipes.instructions:
In a mortar and pestle, grind sesame seeds.
Add sugar, mayonnaise, vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, and salt. Mix
Can serve on a salad.
recipes.author: Aaron and Claire

recipes.title: Thai Salad Dressing
recipes.instructions: Mix ingredients. Serve on salad.
recipes.author: Marion’s Kitchen

recipes.title: Cheese Sauce
recipes.instructions:
Melt butter on pot.
Add flour and mix for 1 minute.
Add milk and mix. Cook until sauce thickens.
Melt cheese in sauce while mixing.
Could add hot sauce and pickled jalapenos as options. Could add salt and pepper.
recipes.author: Easy Peasy Pan

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt Dip
recipes.instructions: Mix all ingredients
recipes.author: Tasty

recipes.title: Fresh Salsa
recipes.instructions: Mix all
recipes.notes: Could add kiwi or strawberries.

recipes.title: Salsa
recipes.instructions:
Peel tomatillos (Do not peel if using roma tomatoes) and slice in half. Place them face down onto another metal sheet.
Cut jalapenos in half and place face down onto the metal sheet. May remove seeds and stem for less spicy. Can add more peppers for more spice.
Smash 3-5 garlic cloves and add to the sheet.
Set the oven to broil and place the metal sheet with the tomatillos, jalapeno, onions, and garlic into the oven until charred. Then transfer to a blender.
In the blender, also add cilantro, salt, and juice from 1 lime. Blend roughly and ready serve. May adjust salt and lime as needed.

recipes.title: Sausage Tomato Dip
recipes.instructions:
Cook sausage on medium heat until cooked. Mix to break apart sausage.
Can strain to remove oil.
Add cream cheese. Continue to cook while stirring.
Strain tomatoes and add to pan. Mix until fully cooked.
Serve as chips and dip.
recipes.author: Ate Cherry

recipes.title: Buttermilk Ranch
recipes.instructions: Mix all ingredients into a mixing bowl.
recipes.author: Kenji Lopez-Alt
recipes.notes: For regular ranch, can omit butter milk and increase sour cream and mayonnaise to ¾ Cups each. Can serve on Baked Buffalo Chicken Wings.

ingredients.name_text: Fresh or dry dill leaves, chopped

recipes.title: Cantonese Chili Oil
recipes.instructions:
Mix chilis, salt, sugar, white pepper, paprika and 1 Tbsp oil into a bowl.
Heat pan on high, then add 4 oz vegetable or corn oil.
In order, add ginger, garlic, shallots, then onion, star anise. Cook long enough until aromatic. Cooking for about 3-4 minutes.
Remove ingredients from the oil.
Reheat oil, keep around 300 degrees F. Can add room temp oil if too hot.
Pour 1 ladle of hot oil onto mixture and mix. Do not add all oil at once to avoid burning.
Sprinkle in some sesame seeds.
Add one ladle of hot oil.
Add 1 Tsp Sesame oil.
recipes.author: Made With Lau
recipes.notes: For spicer or different oils, can try different chilis.Lasts several months in the refrigerator.

ingredients.name_text: Dried chili flakes, or crushed dried chili peppers (Sichuan, or preference)
Optional: 1 Tsp Paprika for red color
Red onion, sliced into thin strips
Star anise, roughly smashed and wet with water

recipes.title: Chimichurri Sauce
recipes.instructions:
If using dried oregano, steep it in a cup of warm water for 3-5 minutes
Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl.
Let sit overnight before serving.
recipes.author: Regester For Dinner
recipes.notes: Could serve with steak, ribs, chicken, burgers.

ingredients.name_text: of Flat Leaf Italian Parsley, stems chopped off, minced
Apple cider vinegar or Red wine vinegar

recipes.title: Crispy Garlic and Garlic Oil
recipes.instructions:
Cook garlic on low heat.
After about 6 minutes, garlic should turn golden brown.
Turn off heat.
Sift oil from garlic.
Let garlic cool before storing in a container to allow it to stay crispy.
recipes.author: Spoon Fork Heart
recipes.notes: Could serve with Maple Fish Sauce Brussels Sprouts

recipes.title: Ginger Scallion Sauce
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pan on high until shimmering or ripples form.
Add ginger and cook for 15 seconds.
Add scallions and cook for 20-30 seconds.
Transfer sauce to a bowl.
Add sesame oil and salt, then mix.
recipes.author: Made With Lau
recipes.notes: Could add soy sauce or oyster sauce.Amount of scallions, ginger, and oil can vary based on preference.Sesame oil is important for the taste. Can serve with Poached Chicken.

recipes.title: Katsu Sauce
recipes.instructions: Mix ingredients to serve.
recipes.author: Aaron and Claire
recipes.notes: Can serve with Chicken Cutlet.

recipes.title: Nam Jim Jaew
recipes.instructions: Toast uncook rice on a dry pan until dark brown. Grind in mortar and pestle.
recipes.author: Pailin’s Kitchen
recipes.notes: - Dipping sauce for meat. - For fatty meats or sweet marinated meat, or thin meats, can make a lighter recipe to adjust ratio. Less sauce will cling to meat: - 1 Tbsp Tamarind - 1.5 Tbsp Lime juice - 2 Tbsp Fish sauce - 1/3 Tbsp Sugar

recipes.title: Prik Nam Pla
recipes.instructions: Add all ingredients together. Store in the refrigerator and it should last a long time.
recipes.author: Pailin’s Kitchen
recipes.notes: - Can start with a ratio of 3:1 Fish sauce to lime juice and adjust to preference. - For more mild spice, can chop chillies into bigger pieces, remove seeds/pith, or add chopped chillies to cold water first and let sit for a few minutes. - Can use on plain/fried rice, fried eggs, pan seared fish/chicken, or, mashed potatoes. - Best fish sauce brands: Squid, Megachef, or Red Boat. Red Boat is a premium brand with more intense fish flavor, and can add sugar to help balance the fish flavor.

Optional: Thinly sliced garlic and/or shallots

recipes.title: Shanghai-Style Scallion Oil
recipes.instructions:
Place cut vegetables into pan and add oil.
High heat until oil starts to bubble gently, then reduce to medium for a slow, lazy bubble. Cook for about 10-15 minutes while stirring to cook evenly.
Remove from the heat and can store in the refrigerator for up to 2 months.
recipes.author: Kenji Lopez-Alt
recipes.notes: Can use in Shanghai-style Noodles.Can serve with Poached Chicken.

ingredients.name_text: Neutral oil (Rice bran, peanut, vegetable, canola, lard, grapeseed)
Scallion/Green onion stalks, cut into 2-inch segments

recipes.title: Stir Fry Sauce
recipes.instructions:
Heat a neutral oil on medium. Add garlic, green onions, and ginger until aromatic.
Add the rest of the ingredients except for sesame oil.
Add vegetables for stir frying
At the end of cooking, add a dash of sesame oil.
recipes.notes: Can cook with Boiled Mushrooms.

recipes.title: Sukang Sawsawan (Spiced Vinegar)
recipes.instructions: Mix all ingredients into a jar and let rest for 30-60 minutes before serving.
recipes.author: TasteGie
recipes.notes: Can add more soy sauce for a darker color.Can substitute onion with cucumber for a milder taste.Can adjust sugar and salt according to taste. Can be paired with grilled or fried dishes, including lumpiang shanghai (spring rolls), vegetable fritters (okoy), barbecue, crispy pata, pork chops, kwek-kwek (quail eggs). Can serve with Pork Tocino.

recipes.title: Thai Basil Sauce
recipes.instructions:
To a small bowl, add soy sauce, oyster sauce, fish sauce, and sugar
To a medium heat pan, add oil. Add onions and saute to preference.
Add garlic and thai chilis.
Once garlic is starting to turn golden, add stock and sauce mixture. Stir.
Add black or white pepper to taste.
Add dark soy sauce and bell peppers.
Turn off heat and add basil. Use residual heat to wilt the basil.
Taste to ensure not too salty. Can add more stock or water.
Can be used as a pour over sauce or stir fry sauce. Heat up the sauce and ladle over a cooked protein. As stir fry, sear protein, stir fry until 80% cooked, add vegetables, Add sauce and stir fry.
recipes.author: Pailin’s Kitchen
recipes.notes: - Will keep in the fridge for at least a week.

recipes.title: Bean Paste Stew
recipes.instructions:
On medium heat, add cooking oil to pot.
Add bean paste, ssamjang, and gochujang. Mix.
Add 2 cups of water.
Add vegetables and beef. Cook until ready.

recipes.title: Miso Soup
recipes.instructions:
Place water and Kombu into pot bringing to a boil.
Bring heat down to medium and add miso paste and stir until dissolved.
Stir in dried wakame and tofu and cook for a couple more minutes.
Serve with scallions on top.
recipes.author: Kenji Lopez-Alt
recipes.notes: Can serve with Miso Glazed SalmonOptional: Could add vegetables and kimchi.

recipes.title: Ramen (Soy Sauce Soup)
recipes.instructions:
Prepare Chashu and seasoned eggs ahead of time.
Add sugar, soy sauce, chicken broth, oyster sauce, sesame oil, garlic, salt, and pepper. Mix and set aside.
Prepare ramen noodles per package instructions.
Add 1.5 Cups hot water to the broth mixture. Add cooked noodles.
Can double the recipe for 2 people.
Top with chashu, eggs, nori, and green onions.
recipes.author: Kimono Mom

recipes.title: Stock (Chicken/Vegetable)
recipes.instructions:
Place ingredients in large mesh basket inside large stock pot. Cover with water. Simmer on back burner for 3-4 hours or until flavors come up. Season as required.
Remove mesh basket containing cooked veggies & bones and place in bowl to drain. Be careful not to splash hot broth. When contents of basket have cooled, discard. Return any drained broth to stock pot.
Place in appropriate containers in 1 cup or 2 cup increments for future cooking needs and Freeze.
recipes.author: Sandy Clement
recipes.notes: To make chicken pho broth, add sugar, salt, fish sauce, star anise, cinnamon. Serve with chicken, rice noodles, and green onions.

large bay leaves or equilivent small leaves

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.instructions:
Add butter, brown sugar, and white sugar to a mixing bowl. Mix until fully mixed, but do not over mix.
Add egg and vanilla extract and mix until very smooth (emulsified).
In another mixing bowl, add flour, baking soda, and chocolate chips. Add salt if using unsalted butter. Mix until combined.
Combine both mixtures. Mix until consistency is not too hard or too soft. Mix until no traces of flour are seen. This mixture can last up to 1 week inside the refrigerator, or can be frozen.
Scoop batter onto a baking pan with parchment paper or silicone baking mat.
Cook at 350 degrees F for 12-14 minutes.
Place on cooling rack until ready to serve.
recipes.author: RV Manabat

ingredients.name_text: Alternative: ½ Cup Unsalted butter, and add ¼ Tsp iodized salt added to flour mixture
Chocolate chips or White Chocolate chips

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Cookies
recipes.instructions:
Add butter, cream cheese, and white sugar to a mixing bowl. Mix until fully mixed, but do not over mix.
Add egg and vanilla extract and mix until very smooth (emulsified).
In another mixing bowl add flour and baking soda. Add salt if using unsalted butter. Mix until combined.
Combine both mixtures. Mix until consistency is not too hard or too soft. Mix until no traces of flour are seen.
Refrigerate mixture for at least 1 hour. This mixture can last up to 1 week inside the refrigerator, or can be frozen.
Scoop batter onto a baking pan with parchment paper or silicone baking mat.
Cook at 375 degrees F for 10-11 minutes.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Rolls
recipes.instructions:
To make the Starter, in a small heavy pot, whisk flour, milk and water together until smooth. Bring to a simmer over medium-low heat and cook, stirring often, until thickened but still pourable, about 10 minutes (it will thicken more as it cools). When it’s ready, the spoon will leave tracks on the bottom of the pot. Scrape into a measuring cup and lightly cover the surface with plastic wrap. Set aside to cool to room temperature.
To make the Dough, In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a dough hook, combine the flour, sugar, yeast and salt and mix for a few seconds, just until evenly combined.
Add egg, milk, and Starter to the Dough. Mix and knead for 5 minutes.
Add soft butter and knead another 10 to 12 minutes (it will take a few minutes for butter to be incorporated), until the dough is smooth and springy and just a bit tacky.
Lightly butter the inside of a bowl. Use your hands to lift dough out of mixer bowl, shape into a ball and place in prepared bowl. Cover with a kitchen towel and let rise in a warm place until doubled in size, 40 to 60 minutes.
After you let the dough rise in a greased covered bowl until it is double in size, you’re ready to roll the cinnamon rolls. Use a pastry mat sprinkled with flour to keep the dough from sticking. Roll out the dough into a rectangle about ¼ inch thick.
After you’ve rolled the dough, spread the cinnamon filling on top and roll-up jelly-roll style. Cut into 12 rolls for a 9×13 pan.
